column13: Non-aqueous membrane emulsion methods for producing polymeric and polymer-coated microparticles are provided. column13: The present invention relates to a sustained-release injectable composition for treating or preventing an inflammatory disease, and a method for preparing the same. column12: Enteric coating for targeting the duodenum
column13: A system for targeted delivery of a medicament to the gastrointestinal tract (e.g., selectively to the duodenum) of a subject. The system includes a medicament, a mucoadhesive layer at least partially surrounding the medicament, and an enteric coating encasing the medicament and mucoadhesive layer. The enteric coating comprises a material degradable by a pH of the GI tract and a material digestible by a lipase. Also provided are method of making and using the system for targeted delivery of a medicament to the gastrointestinal tract. Also provided are a system for deploying a medicament-containing needle system using an expanding element. The system includes a medicament-containing needle system and an expanding element within a capsule. The capsule is initially coated with an enteric coating. As the enteric coating degrades the expanding element absorbs fluid that enters the capsule and expands to deploy the medicament-containing needle system from the capsule.

column12: GRAPHENE-BASED DRUG DELIVERY DEVICE FOR MUCOSAL AND TRANSMUCOSAL ADMINISTRATION
column13: The present invention relates to a device for mucosal and transmucosal drug delivery providing a controlled release of active pharmaceutical ingredients. The drug delivery device has a drug reservoir containing an active pharmaceutical ingredient loaded on graphene and/or its derivatives, such as graphene oxide, and a microcontroller able to connect to an electronic device. The device can also include a biosensor system to collect biometric information in order to interact with the drug delivery in a closed-loop system.

column12: Insecticidal composition and preparation method thereof

Through a hydrogel and microsphere sustained-release system, the stability and persistence of insecticidal active ingredients are improved, the environmental protection problem and long-acting release are solved, and the hydrogel microsphere has wide agricultural application value.

column12: Bone paste for repairing bone trauma and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to bone paste for repairing bone wounds and a preparation method of the bone paste, and belongs to the technical field of biomedical material manufacturing. The bone paste is prepared from nanoscale calcium-phosphorus biphase ceramic, biomimetic mineralized collagen fiber, biodegradable polymer, modified hyaluronic acid, beta-cyclodextrin coated recombinant human bone morphogenetic protein-7, an angiogenesis accelerant and an immunoregulation additive according to a certain proportion. The nano-scale calcium-phosphorus dual-phase ceramic is hydroxyapatite and beta-tricalcium phosphate dual-phase ceramic; the biomimetic mineralized collagenous fiber is prepared by mixing type I collagen freeze-dried fiber with hydroxypropyl chitosan and performing mineralization; the modified hyaluronic acid is hyaluronic acid-sulfydryl and hyaluronic acid-hydrazide; the angiogenesis accelerant is a polylactic acid sustained release microsphere loaded with tanshinone and hydroxyl polyethylene glycol biotin; the immunoregulation additive is disodium glycyrrhizinate, lentinan and astragalus polysaccharide. The bone paste can effectively improve the bone induction capacity, promote vascularization generation and reduce the immunogenicity risk.

column12: Slow-release injection containing levosalbutamol and preparation process thereof
column13: The invention provides a slow-release injection containing levosalbutamol and a preparation process thereof, the injection combines a ginkgo leaf extract, a resveratrol extract, vitamin B6, vitamin C, tea polyphenol and other auxiliary components, and through specific preparation steps, the injection can be prepared into the slow-release injection containing levosalbutamol. Comprising the following steps: preparing raw materials, mixing and dissolving, preparing a slow-release carrier, adjusting pH, filtering, filling, sterilizing and the like, thereby obtaining the injection with the slow-release effect. column12: Alltrenogest sustained-release medicament and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses an altrenogest sustained-release medicament as well as a preparation process and application thereof, and relates to the field of veterinary drugs. When the altrenogest sustained-release medicament is prepared, altrenogest reacts with carboxyl-terminated polylactic acid-glycolic acid to prepare drug-loaded nano-particles, chitosan reacts with 3, 4-dihydroxyphenylpropionic acid and then reacts with a carbodiimide solution to prepare modified chitosan, and the modified chitosan and the 3, 4-dihydroxyphenylpropionic acid react to prepare the altrenogest sustained-release medicament. The preparation method comprises the following steps: activating drug-loaded nano-particles with 1-ethyl-(3-dimethylaminopropyl) carbodiimide hydrochloride and N-hydroxysuccinimide, and then reacting with a modified chitosan solution to prepare hydrophilic drug-loaded nano-particles; the hydrophilic drug-loaded nanoparticles, hydroxypropyl-beta-cyclodextrin, magnesium stearate, hydroxy propyl cellulose and lactose are pressed into tablets by a direct tabletting method to prepare the medicine-loaded hydrogel. The altrenogest sustained-release medicament prepared by the invention has good sustained-release performance and drug release rate.

column12: Selenium-iron co-doped hydroxyapatite reinforced polylactic acid stent and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a selenium-iron co-doped hydroxyapatite reinforced polylactic acid scaffold and a preparation method thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: co-doping SeO3 < 2-> and Fe < 3 + > into HAP through a co-precipitation method to obtain SF-HAP powder; sF-HAP and PLLA are dispersed in ethyl alcohol, and PLLA/SF-HAP composite powder is obtained through stirring, centrifuging, drying and the like; the PLLA/SF-HAP biological scaffold is prepared through an additive manufacturing technology, in order to endow the PLLA/HAP bone scaffold with an anti-tumor function, Fe is doped into HAP, a Fenton reaction can be promoted in an osteosarcoma environment so that ROS can be generated to kill tumor cells, but overexpressed GSH existing in the tumor cells can consume the ROS to weaken the anti-tumor effect, and doping of Se and Fe can reduce the crystallinity of HAP crystals, so that the anti-tumor effect is improved. column12: DRUG DELIVERY DEVICES HAVING SEPARABLE MICRONEEDLES AND METHODS
column13: Drug delivery devices and methods are provided for delivering one or more drugs into a biological tissue. The devices include microneedles that may be separable from the drug delivery devices, control drug release rate and/or direction, or a combination thereof. When the microneedles are separable, a force applied to the drug delivery devices may be effective to penetrate a biological tissue with the microneedles and then to separate the microneedles from the drug delivery devices. The drug delivery devices may be capable of achieving discrete periods of drug release. Methods for delivery drug with microneedles also are provided.

column12: Construction and application of oral gel drug delivery system based on yeast microcapsules

The gel prepared by combining pectin can prolong the residence time of the drug in the intestinal tract, realizes continuous release, reduces the whole-body side effect of budesonide, and improves the treatment efficiency.

column12: OCTREOTIDE ACETATE SUSTAINED-RELEASE MICROSPHERE, PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR, AND USE THEREOF
column13: An octreotide acetate sustained-release microsphere, a preparation method therefor, and a use thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: S1, dissolving a polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer in a first organic solvent to prepare an oil phase 1, and dissolving octreotide acetate in a second organic solvent to prepare an oil phase 2; S2, adding the oil phase 2 into the oil phase 1 while stirring to obtain a suspension containing octreotide acetate; S3, transferring the suspension into a water phase for emulsification to obtain a semi-cured drug-loaded microsphere; and S4, transferring the semi-cured drug-loaded microsphere into a curing phase, and removing the solvent to obtain an octreotide acetate sustained-release microsphere. The octreotide acetate sustained-release microsphere having high drug loading efficiency and high encapsulation efficiency is prepared; and upon experimental tests, the encapsulation efficiency can reach 90% or above, the drug stability is good, and the bioavailability is high, so that the octreotide acetate shows higher application value and a more remarkable use effect.

column12: Preparation method of biocompatible dual-targeting drug delivery dimer nanoparticles
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of biocompatible dual-targeting drug delivery dimer nanoparticles, and belongs to the field of granular materials. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing shellac-polylactic acid dimer nano-particles by utilizing a flash nano-precipitation method based on a phase separation principle, and modifying a targeting molecule 1 of a targeting cancer cell membrane on a polylactic acid hemisphere through molecular self-assembly in the process; and then modifying targeting molecules 2 targeting organ mitochondria in cancer cells on the shellac hemispheres through electrostatic interaction to prepare the double-targeting shellac-polylactic acid dimer nanoparticles. Different targeting molecules are respectively modified on the surfaces of two independent hemispheres of the dimer nanoparticles to realize step-by-step targeting delivery, cancer cell membrane targeting can improve the preliminary recognition and combination of the nanoparticles to cancer cells, and the drug can smoothly enter the cells; and the drug is further guided to reach a key subcellular organelle part through mitochondrial targeting, so that a stronger treatment effect is achieved.

column12: Traditional Chinese medicine composition pill for treating diabetes and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the field of traditional Chinese medicine preparations, and particularly relates to a traditional Chinese medicine composition pill for treating diabetes and a preparation method thereof. The traditional Chinese medicine composition pill is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 50 to 60 parts of traditional Chinese medicine composition, 20 to 30 parts of ethyl cellulose, 5 to 8 parts of polyethylene glycol, 15 to 20 parts of polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer, 8 to 12 parts of graft modified hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose, 25 to 30 parts of microcrystalline cellulose, 1 to 3 parts of silicon dioxide, 2 to 5 parts of magnesium stearate, 0.5 to 1 part of surfactant and 0.5 to 1 part of antioxidant. column12: Anti-VEGF (vascular endothelial growth factor) intraocular sustained-release implant with high drug loading capacity and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses an anti-VEGF (vascular endothelial growth factor) intraocular sustained-release implant with high drug loading capacity and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of medicines. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, uniformly mixing crushed and sieved anti-VEGF active ingredients with a water-insoluble biodegradable sustained-release polymer to obtain premixed powder, setting the temperature of a hot-melt extruder and the rotating speed of a screw, mounting a mold, preheating, completely feeding the premixed powder, timing for 5-30 minutes, and starting extrusion to obtain the anti-VEGF intraocular sustained-release implant. Wherein the anti-VEGF medicine is prepared from ethanesulfonic acid nintedanib, nintedanib and voranib, and the water-insoluble biodegradable slow-release polymer is prepared from polylactic acid, a polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer and polycaprolactone. The in-vitro release characteristic of the prepared anti-VEGF intraocular sustained-release implant conforms to a zero-order release model, and the implant has an excellent sustained-release effect.

column12: Photo-thermal responsive bionic core-shell microneedle patch as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a photo-thermal responsive bionic core-shell microneedle patch as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The microneedle patch comprises a backing layer and a plurality of core-shell microneedles arranged on the backing layer, the core-shell microneedle comprises an external microneedle shell and an internal phase change core; the microneedle shell is made of a polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer; the phase-change core is formed by mixing phase-change materials with photo-thermal characteristics, namely black phosphorus, gelatin and carrageenan, and a loaded drug, and has proper phase-change temperature and temperature rising performance, so that the high efficiency and safety of a drug delivery mode are ensured. The prepared microneedle patch has the advantages of being almost painless, minimally invasive, harmless to the body, not prone to infection, convenient to use, easy to operate and the like, the compliance of a patient is good, the administration speed can be regulated and controlled through external stimulation, and the microneedle patch is slowly administered without stimulation and is stable in effect.

column12: Microspheres in which physiologically active substances are uniformly dispersed, and sustained release preparation containing same

column12: PREPARATION METHOD AND APPLICATION METHOD OF INJECTABLE PLA MICROSPHERES

The preparation method of the injectable PLA microspheres include: S01, preparing a spray solution; S02, performing homogeneous emulsification on the spray solution to obtain an emulsified spray solution; and S03, drying the emulsified spray solution. The spray solution includes an oil phase and an aqueous phase, and a weight ratio of the oil phase and the aqueous phase is 1-10:1-10. The oil phase includes PLA and an organic solvent, and the aqueous phase includes a surfactant, macromolecular substances and deionized water. A particle size of the injectable PLA microspheres is basically below 60 μm, and the injectable PLA microspheres have a complete form, are independent of each other, do not exhibit agglomeration and have good biocompatibility, which can satisfy the requirement of the injection.

column12: BIO-ENGINEERED HUMAN PROSTATE GLAND AND DISEASE MODEL
column13: Microfluidic devices, organ-on-a-chip platforms (e.g. mimicking the human prostate gland), and uses thereof are described herein. The microfluidic device includes at least two layers and a porous membrane therebetween. Each layer includes a channel, and the first channel and the second channel are aligned such that a first region of a first channel overlaps with a region of the second channel, and a second region of the first channel does not overlap a second region of the second channel. A disease model using the microfluidic devices includes (i) placing a first type of cells in the first channel and (ii) flowing a first cell culture medium through the first channel. column12: Preparation method of double-effect drug sustained release microsphere system with core-shell structure suitable for articular cavity injection
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a double-effect drug sustained release microsphere system which is suitable for articular cavity injection and has a core-shell structure, and belongs to the field of tissue engineering. The preparation method of the microsphere system comprises the following steps: adding a methylprednisolone sodium succinate (MPSS) solution into an organic solvent dissolved with polylactic acid and KGN for emulsification, dropwise adding the obtained W1/O system into a polyvinyl alcohol solution for emulsification, and centrifuging, cleaning, freezing and drying the obtained W1/O/W2 system to obtain the microsphere system. The polylactic acid is used as a carrier material, an anti-inflammatory drug MPSS is loaded to a core layer by adopting a solvent evaporation method, a cartilage regeneration promoting drug KGN is loaded to a shell layer, and time-space gradient slow release of the two drugs is realized. The microsphere system disclosed by the invention has good cell biocompatibility, chondrogenesis induction activity and anti-inflammatory activity, can realize short-acting slow release of shell layer drugs and long-acting slow release of core layer drugs, and has potential application value in the field of articular cavity injection.

column12: Bifunctional slow-release nano-drug delivery system with ROS responsiveness and application of bifunctional slow-release nano-drug delivery system
column13: The invention belongs to the field of biological medicine and pharmacology, and particularly relates to a difunctional slow-release nano drug delivery system with active oxygen responsiveness and application of the difunctional slow-release nano drug delivery system. The drug delivery system is composed of two parts, in one part, mesoporous silica is used for loading vitepofen, the surface of the mesoporous silica is wrapped with polydopamine to form PMSN-VP nano particles, in the other part, phenylboronic acid functionalized polylactic acid-glycolic acid-polyethylene glycol copolymer is used for wrapping cerium oxide quantum dots to form PPCeO2NPs, and in the other part, the PPCeO2NPs is used for coating cerium oxide quantum dots. The two parts are connected through a boric acid ester bond formed by a phenolic hydroxyl group on the surface of the PDA and a phenylboronic acid group on the PBA. According to the invention, PMSN-VP NPs can down-regulate factors related to angiogenesis and exert an anti-angiogenesis function, PPCeO2NPs can down-regulate expression of proinflammatory factors and exert an anti-inflammatory function, and meanwhile, a borate bond can be broken in an ROS environment, so that the drug delivery system is endowed with a responsive drug release capability.

column12: A METHOD FOR PREPARING MICROPARTICLES FOR DRUG DELIVERY
column13: Disclosed is a method for preparing microparticles for drug delivery. The method comprises providing a mold comprising multiple individual, open compartments arranged on a first surface of the mold. The open compartments are separated from each other by one or more edges. Each edge has a width of 5 µm or less. The method comprises coating the first surface of the mold with a mold layer comprising a biocompatible and/or biodegradable material having a first release characteristic at a first condition. The method comprises loading the compartments coated with the mold layer with a pharmaceutical composition comprising a drug substance. The method comprises coating the first surface of the mold with a top layer comprising a biocompatible and/or biodegradable material having a second release characteristic at the first condition for provision of closed microparticles in the multiple individual compartments. The method comprises separating the closed microparticles by cutting the mold layer and the top layer using the one or more edges. By cutting the mold layer and the top layer using the one or more edges discrete microparticles are provided.

column12: COMPOSITE GEL, PREPARATION METHOD, AND APPLICATION
column13: The present disclosure relates to the technical field of biomedical materials. Provided are a composite gel, and a preparation method and an application thereof. column12: Nano motor and application thereof in preparation of anti-tumor immunotherapy drugs
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines and nano preparations, and particularly relates to a nano motor and application thereof in preparation of anti-tumor immunotherapy drugs. The nano motor is composed of a nano carrier, a ferroptosis drug and an ultrasonic enhancer. Polyethylene glycol (PEG) modified polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer (PLGA) nanoparticles are preferably selected as the nano-carrier, gambogic acid is preferably selected as the ferroptosis drug, and perfluorobromooctane is preferably selected as the ultrasonic enhancer. The nanomotor is prepared by a nanoprecipitation method or a microfluidic method. The materials are simple and easy to obtain, the preparation operation is simple and convenient, the prepared nano motor has excellent high intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) response performance, deep driving and efficient accumulation towards a focus part can be realized under the action of HIFU, and controllable release of a medicine at a tumor part is realized. Meanwhile, the nano motor can cooperate with HIFU to enhance the ferroptosis effect of tumor cells, activate the anti-tumor immune effect of the body and inhibit the growth and metastasis of tumors.

column12: DRUG-LOADED BALLOON AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR
column13: A drug coated balloon and a preparation method thereof are provided. The drug coated balloon includes a balloon body and a drug loaded coating layer. The drug loaded coating layer includes a first drug loaded coating component having at least two controllable sustained release drugs with different drug release kinetics, and a second drug loaded coating component including an active drug in a free unbound form. The second drug loaded coating component is dispersed among the controllable sustained release drugs in the first drug loaded coating component and couples the controllable sustained release drugs on the balloon body. The first and second drug loaded coatings component are both non-hydrophilic compositions. The drug coated balloon can provide sufficient initial drug loading dosage to the lesion site, and multiple controllable sustained release drugs having different drug release kinetics is able to avoid explosive drug release and extinction. The drug release rate can also be regulated through different combinations, thereby allowing the drug coated balloon to provide bioactive drugs to the treatment site at different stages of the cascade reaction of vascular restenosis, providing the controllable long-acting therapeutic drugs to the lesion site, and improving the overall vascular drug release efficacy.

column12: Electro-response nano-particles for treating or diagnosing epilepsy as well as preparation method and application of electro-response nano-particles
column13: The invention provides an electric response nanoparticle for treating or diagnosing epilepsy as well as a preparation method and application of the electric response nanoparticle, and the electric response nanoparticle is a nano-micelle particle formed by self-assembling a polymer and an active component related to the treatment or diagnosis of epilepsy as raw materials, the polymer comprises ferrocene modified polyethylene glycol, beta-cyclodextrin modified polylactic acid, a nasal epithelial cell-penetrating peptide modified polyethylene glycol-polylactic acid block copolymer and a neuron targeting peptide modified polyethylene glycol-polylactic acid block copolymer, the active component related to epilepsy treatment or diagnosis comprises an anti-epilepsy active component and/or a fluorescent probe. The preparation method provided by the invention is simple and convenient to operate, clear in synthesis path, short in response time, high in release efficiency, capable of bypassing a blood brain barrier after nasal administration, rapid in brain entering and stable in drug release amount, and suitable for targeted delivery of various drugs and treatment and diagnosis of epilepsy.

column12: COMPOSITION FOR ORGAN-SPECIFIC DELIVERY OF NUCLEIC ACID
column13: The present application provides a composition for organ-specific delivery of nucleic acids, which comprises a guided on-target lipid delivery lipid; further, the composition may comprise a helper lipid; still further, the composition may comprise a cationic lipid. The guided on-target lipid delivery lipid may be selected from one or more of an ionizable anionic steroid and/or an ionizable anionic polymer conjugated lipid; the helper lipid is optionally one or more of a phospholipid, a steroid, a polymer conjugated lipid, and a modifiable lipid; and the cationic lipid may be selected from one or more of a permanently cationic lipid and/or an ionizable cationic lipid. The delivery composition is capable of specifically delivering a prophylactic/therapeutic agent, particularly a nucleic acid component, to a target organ.

column12: Nanoparticles capable of targeting glioma cells as well as preparation method and application of nanoparticles
column13: The invention discloses nanoparticles capable of targeting glioma cells as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: step S1, preparing nanoparticles of a spherical polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer; s2, extracting a cell membrane of the glioma cell capable of expressing the RGD sequence; and S3, mixing the nano-particles of the polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer prepared in the step S1 with the cell membrane of the glioma cell capable of expressing the RGD sequence extracted in the step S2 to prepare the nano-particles capable of targeting the glioma cell. The nanoparticles can be applied to preparation of drugs for treating gliocytoma. The nanoparticles provided by the invention can significantly inhibit formation of glioma migrators and cell migration, have a positive therapeutic effect on treatment of glioma cells, and have huge potential as a targeted drug carrier due to efficient targeting, good blood-brain barrier permeability, good stability and biological safety.

column12: A METHOD FOR PRODUCING A THREE-DIMENSIONAL MICROPOROUS FILAMENT CONSTRUCT
column13: A method for producing a three-dimensional macro-porous filament construct having interconnected microporous filaments comprises: a) preparing a mixture comprising particles of one or more metals, one or more metal alloys or a combination thereof, one or more binders, a first liquid solvent for the one or more binders, and optionally one or more dispersants; b) dispersing particles containing at least one removable additive in said mixture; c) depositing said mixture in the form of filaments in a predetermined three-dimensional pattern of interconnected filaments, thereby creating a three-dimensional filament-based porous green structure; d) contacting the three-dimensional filament-based porous green structure formed in step c) with a second solvent which is a non-solvent for the one or more binders to induce phase inversion thereby creating a filament-based phase inverted porous structure having a filament micro-porosity, whereby at least part of said filaments are transformed to a solid state; e) removing the at least one removable additive by dissolving in a removal agent to create additional micro-porosity in the phase inverted porous structure; f) subjecting the thus obtained structure to a thermal treatment. The removal agent comprises or consists of the second liquid solvent, or the removal agent is a third liquid solvent distinct from the second liquid solvent.

column12: Core-satellite micelle including tetra-block copolymer and preparation method thereof
column13: Proposed are a core-satellite micelle containing a tetra-block copolymer and a preparation method thereof. The core-satellite micelle includes a core, a shell surrounding the core, and a plurality of satellite domains positioned inside the shell. The core-satellite micelle contains a tetra-block copolymer represented by Structural Formula 1 below. The shell includes a first-monomer first block A1 and a first-monomer second block A2, and the satellite domain includes a second-monomer first block B1 and a second-monomer second block B2. The core-satellite micelle is foiled through self-assembly of the tetra-block copolymer, thereby having a larger interfacial contact area than existing block-copolymer micelles. Therefore, the core-satellite micelle can be used in next-generation nanotechnology applications such as drug delivery systems, porous catalyst materials, and sensors.A1-B1-A2-B2 [Structural Formula 1]In Structural Formula 1,A1 is a first-monomer first block,B1 is a second-monomer first block,A2 is a first-monomer second block, andB2 is a second-monomer second block.

column12: M2 type macrophage membrane coated baicalin nanoparticles for regulating and controlling cerebral ischemia microenvironment as well as preparation method and application of M2 type macrophage membrane coated baicalin nanoparticles
column13: The invention discloses M2 type macrophage membrane coated baicalin nanoparticles for regulating and controlling a cerebral ischemia microenvironment as well as a preparation method and application of the M2 type macrophage membrane coated baicalin nanoparticles. According to the preparation method, polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer is taken as a raw material, a model drug baicalin is loaded through hydrophobic force, M2 type macrophage membrane is taken as a shell to wrap the surfaces of drug-loaded nanoparticles, and the M2 type macrophage membrane wrapped bionic nano drug delivery system is prepared. The M2 type macrophage membrane coated baicalin nanoparticle bionic nano drug delivery system constructed by the invention can target a cerebral ischemia reperfusion focus and damaged microglial cells and nerve cells, and regulates and controls the inflammatory microenvironment of the focus by recoding the phenotype of the microglial cells and inhibiting neutrophil infiltration; meanwhile, the effect of treating cerebral ischemia is achieved by inhibiting nerve cell apoptosis. The M2 type macrophage membrane used in the invention provides a new treatment thought for brain inflammation related diseases, and has a good clinical transformation prospect.

column12: LONG-ACTING SUSTAINED-RELEASE PRAMIPEXOLE PREPARATION AND METHOD FOR PREPARING SAME
column13: Provided are a long-acting sustained-release pramipexole preparation and a method for preparing same. The long-acting sustained-release pramipexole preparation comprises pramipexole pamoate or pramipexole palmitate, and a polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer or polylactic acid. The drug loading capacity of the preparation is 10% -50%. The molar ratio of lactic acid to glycolic acid of the polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer is 85:15-95:5. The microsphere is round in shape, smooth in surface and free of pores, and can effectively reduce the early burst release of the drug and solve the problem of high burst release of existing pramipexole pamoate microspheres. Also, the present invention features an effectively prolonged sustained-release period that solves the problem of the short release period of the existing pramipexole pamoate microspheres, and a smaller blood concentration fluctuation that leads to a more stable release.

column12: Core-shell type nano-enzyme probe as well as preparation method and application thereof

column12: Preparation of nano-drug delivery system for targeting atherosclerotic plaque
column13: The invention discloses preparation of a nano-drug delivery system for targeting atherosclerotic plaque, and relates to the technical field of medicines. Comprising the following steps: (1) mixing a polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer and a hydrophobic lipid-lowering drug in a solvent to obtain a micelle solution; (2) treating fresh animal whole blood, collecting red blood cells, washing with a sterile isotonic solution, and suspending the red blood cells in a PBS (Phosphate Buffer Solution) to obtain diluted RBCs; and (3) adding the micelle solution prepared in the step (1) into the diluted RBCs prepared in the step (2), incubating at room temperature, and washing to obtain the RBCs. The medicine prepared through combined action of the blood fat reducing medicine and the polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer has the advantages of being good in biocompatibility, safety, targeted modification and the like, is good in treatment effect and can reduce the side effect risk caused by acting on non-target parts.

column12: Nanofiber dressing

column12: COATED MICRONEEDLE WITH MULTILAYER STRUCTURE, METHOD FOR PREPARING THE SAME AND MICRONEEDLE PATCH COMPRISING COATED MICRONEEDLE
column13: The present application discloses a coated microneedle with a multilayer structure, including a base, a needle tip on the base, and a functional coating. The functional coating includes a content including a water-soluble polymer material and an active ingredient, and a sustained-release layer wrapping the content. The sustained-release layer covers the needle tip. The coated microneedle can prevent a drug-containing matrix from being quickly dissolved and dispersed, prevent the active ingredient from exuding along with tissues at an action site, and increase the drug intake. The present application further discloses a method for preparing the coated microneedle and a microneedle patch including the coated microneedle.

column12: WATER-SOLUBLE CANNABINOID FORMULATION AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR
column13: Disclosed are a water-soluble cannabinoid formulation and a preparation method therefor. The water-soluble cannabinoid formulation comprises a cannabinoid, an amphiphilic high-molecular polymer and cyclodextrin, wherein the content of the cannabinoid in percentages by weight is 1-40%, the content of the amphiphilic high-molecular polymer in percentages by weight is 1-90%, and the content of the cyclodextrin in percentages by weight is 1-90%; and the preparation method comprises: (1) preparing a water-soluble composite solution from a cannabinoid, an amphiphilic high-molecular polymer and cyclodextrin; (2) drying the water-soluble composite solution obtained in step (1) to obtain water-soluble cannabinoid solid particles; and (3) preparing the cannabinoid solid particles obtained in step (2) into a water-soluble cannabinoid formulation. The water-soluble cannabinoid formulation has a high drug loading capacity, a low water consumption during preparation, a strong stability, a simple process, a low cost and a short inclusion time.

column12: Preparation method of fibroin drug carrier
column13: The invention relates to a preparation method of a silk protein drug carrier, which comprises the following steps: introducing a hydrophilic chain end to the tail end of a molecular chain of polylactic acid to change the hydrophobicity of polylactic acid, mixing with silk fibroin, and self-assembling to form nano microspheres which can be used for drug loading and drug sustained-release treatment; the specific surface area of the nano-microspheres is large, so that the speed of degrading and releasing drugs by the nano-microspheres with large particle sizes is higher than that of the nano-microspheres with small particle sizes; meanwhile, during self-assembly, nano ferroferric oxide particles are added, so that the prepared drug carrier has a certain magnetic attraction force and can release drugs in a targeted manner.

column12: BIOLOGICAL FUNCTION COMPOSITE POROUS POLYESTER MICROSPHERES AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR
column13: The present invention provides biological function composite porous polyester microspheres, the polyester forming the polyester microspheres being a mixture of polylactic acid (PLA) and poly(lactic-co-glycolic acid) (PLGA); the PLGA comprises one or more of PLGA, end-group modified PLGA and bonded PLGA; the end-group modified PLGA is amino or carboxyl modified PLGA; and the bonded PLGA is end-group modified PLGA which undergoes an amino or carboxyl chemical bonding method to become loaded with one or more of hyaluronic acid (HA), collagen (Col) and cytokines. The microspheres prepared in the present invention are round in shape, have a uniform particle size distribution, have high and adjustable porosity, and simultaneously have high drug loading capacity and encapsulation efficiency. The invention can achieve controllable release of bioactive molecules in an early stage, middle stage and later stage, that is, by adjusting the mass ratios of PLA and PLGA in the polyester microspheres the degradation time thereof in the body can be adjusted, for instance to 2 months, 6 months, 24 months, etc., thus bringing about biological effects at different times.

column12: Triamcinolone acetonide sustained release microsphere, preparation method and triamcinolone acetonide sustained release preparation
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of drug sustained-release preparations, and particularly relates to a triamcinolone acetonide sustained-release microsphere, a preparation method and a triamcinolone acetonide sustained-release preparation. The preparation method of the triamcinolone acetonide sustained-release microspheres comprises the following steps: adding an organic phase containing a solvent dichloromethane, a triamcinolone acetonide bulk drug, a polylactic acid-glycollic acid copolymer and dioctyl sodium sulfosuccinate into a water phase, emulsifying to form an emulsion, and curing emulsion drops dispersed in the emulsion to form the triamcinolone acetonide sustained-release microspheres. In the method, the organic phase and the water phase are homogeneous solutions respectively, so that the organic phase and the water phase can be filtered and sterilized respectively after the preparation of the organic phase and the water phase is completed, and the sustained-release microsphere product is ensured to meet the sterile requirement. In addition, the triamcinolone acetonide sustained-release microspheres prepared by the method are high in encapsulation efficiency, large in drug loading capacity, less in solvent residue, uniform in particle size distribution and stable and long-acting in drug release.

column12: GRAPHENE-BASED DRUG DELIVERY DEVICE FOR MUCOSAL AND TRANSMUCOSAL ADMINISTRATION
column13: The present invention relates to a device for mucosal and transmucosal drug delivery providing a controlled release of active pharmaceutical ingredients. The drug delivery device of the invention comprises at least one drug reservoir, said drug reservoir comprising at least one active pharmaceutical ingredient loaded on graphene and/or its derivatives, such as graphene oxide, and a microcontroller able to deliver electrical current and able to connect to an electronic device, wherein the release of the active pharmaceutical ingredient from said drug reservoir is controlled by said microcontroller. The device can also comprise a biosensor system to collect biometric information in order to interact with the drug delivery in a closed-loop system.

column12: Injectable and biodegradable polymer formulations for controlled release of bioactive agents
column13: The present disclosure is directed to injectable formulations that include biodegradable polymers based on trimethylene carbonate (TMC) with mole fractions of polylactic acid (PLA) and/or polyglycolic acid (PGA) that are used to deliver a bioactive agent to a targeted site. Excipients such as polyethylene glycol (PEG) may be added to the formulations to reduce the injection force and/or to modulate the release of the bioactive agent. Suitable biodegradable polymers for use in the injectable formulations include D,L-PLA:TMC, D-PLA:TMC, L-PLA:TMC, TMC:PLA:PGA and variations thereof. Additionally, copolymers of TMC and PLA and terpolymers of TMC:PLA:PGA may be formed into nanoparticles and delivered to the target site with an injectable crosslinkable polyethylene glycol system. In at least one embodiment, the injectable formulations are used to treat ocular diseases.

column12: COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS TO PROMOTE BRAIN HEALTH
column13: The present disclosure provides a composition comprising an active ingredient that is encapsulated in suspension of particles comprising a biodegradable polymer containing an effective amount of the active ingredient, wherein the particles are configured to bypass the blood brain barrier, wherein the nutraceutical agent is synthetic D-beta hydroxybutyrate, and wherein targeted delivery is to the brain. It further provides a method for promoting healing of the brain after a traumatic brain injury comprising neuroinflammation and a method for promoting brain health. It further provides a pharmaceutical composition for use in reducing risk of brain damage due to an acquired brain injury in a subject susceptible to, or otherwise at risk of, the acquired brain injury, said composition comprising a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier and a formulation comprising a therapeutic amount of an API, wherein the API is a synthetic D-beta-hydroxybutyrate, wherein the treatment comprises targeted delivery to the olfactory region of the nasal cavity of the subject by administering the composition intranasally (a) before the subject participates in an event where an acquired brain injury is a known risk; (b) after the subject participates in the event for use in treating symptoms of the acquired brain injury of the subject comprising neuroinflammation; or both, wherein the treatment is neuroprotective.

The nano fluazinam sustained-release agent provided by the invention comprises a sustained-release capsule dispersed in water, the sustained-release capsule is of a core-shell structure, the core of the core-shell structure is a fluazinam active compound, and the shell of the core-shell structure is a carrier and a surfactant; the carrier material is ethyl cellulose or polylactic acid; the surfactant comprises one or more of maleated rosin polyoxypropylene oxyethylene ether sulfonates, maleated rosin octyl phenol polyoxyethylene ether diester acid sodium salt, polyvinyl alcohol, polyoxyethylene ether, polyoxyethylene alcohol, polyurethane, polyethylene glycol, polyvinyl alcohol, polyvinyl ether and polyethylene amide. The surfactant and the carrier are combined together through intermolecular acting force or cross winding between molecular chains, so that the surface tension of the fluazinam sustained-release agent can be reduced while the fluazinam release rate is reduced, the lasting period is prolonged, and the utilization rate of the agent is improved.

column12: Chitin whisker coated polylactic acid microspheres and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a chitin whisker coated polylactic acid microsphere and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, ultrasonically dispersing the chitin whiskers into purified water to prepare a chitin whisker dispersion liquid; then, preparing a polylactic acid dichloromethane solution with a certain concentration; slowly adding a polylactic acid-dichloromethane solution into the chitin whisker dispersion liquid, and emulsifying and dispersing by using an emulsifying machine to obtain an emulsion; stirring the emulsion to obtain turbid liquid; centrifuging the turbid liquid, adding water for resuspending, centrifuging and drying to obtain a product. The polylactic acid microspheres are obtained by wrapping the chitin whiskers, the chitin whiskers are used as an emulsifier, and the surfaces of the prepared microspheres are wrapped with the chitin whiskers. The chitin whisker coated polylactic acid microspheres prepared by the method possibly have wide application prospects in the aspects of tissue engineering, drug delivery systems, embolism, cell culture and the like.

column12: Preparation process of PLA (polylactic acid) microspheres for controlled release of drugs
column13: The invention discloses a preparation process of PLA (polylactic acid) microspheres for controlled release of drugs, and belongs to the technical field of polymer microspheres. The preparation process comprises the following steps: S01, preparing an organic solvent; s02, preparing a high polymer material, wherein the high polymer material comprises PLA and an additive; s03, mixing the high polymer material in S02 with the organic solvent in S01, and slowly mixing with the PVA aqueous solution; and S04, stirring, volatilizing the solvent, separating, washing and drying to obtain the PLA microspheres for controlled release of the medicine. The PLA microspheres obtained by the preparation process of the PLA microspheres for the controlled release of the medicine, disclosed by the invention, are regular in ball formation, smooth in surface, free from adhesion and relatively concentrated in particle size distribution.

column12: Photodynamic therapy technique for preventing damage to the fovea of the eye or another body portion of a patient
column13: A photodynamic therapy technique for preventing damage to the fovea of the eye or another body portion of a patient is disclosed herein. In one embodiment, a treatment laser is applied to a body portion of a patient using a painting technique, the treatment laser being configured to provide paint brush-type photodynamic therapy (PPDT) using the painting technique to the body portion of the patient by emitting light of a predetermined wavelength that is absorbed by tissue of the body portion of the patient to which a photosensitizer has been applied, the body portion of the patient being afflicted by a medical condition. The application of the treatment laser to the body portion of a patient using the painting technique treats the medical condition, reduces the symptoms associated with the medical condition, and/or alleviates the medical condition.

column13: The invention relates to a degradable nanofiber membrane material with a hydrophilic core and a hydrophobic shell and a preparation method of the degradable nanofiber membrane material, and belongs to the technical field of medical biological materials. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) preparing sericin powder; (2) preparing a sericin and polyvinyl alcohol nuclear layer mixed solution by taking water as a solvent; (3) preparing a polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer shell solution; (4) preparing a composite nanofiber with a core-shell structure through a coaxial electrostatic spinning technology; and (5) preparing the antibacterial coating. column12: Injectable functionalized collagen-based hydrogel for cartilage repair
column13: The invention discloses injectable functionalized collagen-based hydrogel for cartilage repair. The hydrogel is prepared by crosslinking a hydrogel precursor solution in a constant-temperature environment of 37 DEG C, the hydrogel precursor solution is prepared by adding a functional component into a neutral collagen solution; the functional component is selected from one or two of a stem cell collection component or a cartilage induction component; the stem cell collection component is selected from one of an aptamer Apt19S or a modified product of the aptamer Apt19S; the cartilage induction component is selected from one of Kartogenin or a load product of Kartogenin; the modified product of the aptamer Apt19S is an aptamer Apt19S-CHO modified by an aldehyde group. The Kartogenin loaded product is prepared by taking a polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer as a material and adopting an oil-in-water method to prepare the PLGA microspheres loaded with the Kartogenin. The injectable functionalized collagen-based hydrogel disclosed by the invention has the characteristics of controllably releasing active ingredients, collecting endogenous stem cells, promoting cartilage differentiation and the like, and can be used for promoting cartilage defect repair.

column12: BIOERODIBLE DRUG DELIVERY DEVICES
column13: This invention relates to a bioerodible drug delivery device that can be implanted in a patient at or near an area in need of treatment. column12: Casein-based electrostatic spinning composite fiber loaded with baicalin and preparation method of casein-based electrostatic spinning composite fiber
column13: The invention discloses a baicalin-loaded casein-based electrostatic spinning composite fiber and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: by taking casein as a matrix, firstly, realizing efficient loading of baicalin on the casein under the driving of ultrasonic waves; secondly, enabling casein and polylactic acid to fully act under the driving of ultrasonic waves to realize effective encapsulation of baicalin; and finally, preparing the composite fiber membrane by adopting an electrostatic spinning technology. The casein-based electrostatic spinning composite fiber prepared by the preparation method disclosed by the invention is nanoscale in diameter, good in fiber uniformity, high in drug loading capacity, large in specific surface area and good in swelling property. In addition, the fibrous membrane has good surface hydrophobicity, has a controlled release effect on baicalin, can be used as a medical skin auxiliary material, and is beneficial to improving the absorption and utilization rate of the baicalin. Moreover, the composite fiber matrix is a biosafety material, has no toxic or side effect on human organs, has degradability, does not cause environmental harm, and accords with the innovative development requirements of high-end preparations in the biological medicine industry and the green and low-carbon development concept.

column13: Disclosed herein are advantageous drug delivery assemblies, and related methods of fabrication and use thereof. The present disclosure provides improved drug delivery assemblies for extended drug delivery (e.g., via passive diffusion) and/or tunability, and improved systems/methods for utilizing and fabricating the drug delivery assemblies. More particularly, the present disclosure provides single or dual compartment, and dual porous membrane based (e.g., porous zinc membrane based) drug delivery assemblies for extended drug delivery (e.g., via passive diffusion) and/or tunability. The present disclosure also provides for a method for utilizing a drug delivery assembly. The assemblies can be utilized for the extended drug delivery of pharmaceuticals or the like, such as biologics, for the sustained release of medication for greater than six months to overcome difficulties with daily dosing regimes.

column12: Persulfate sustained-release material and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a persulfate sustained-release material and a preparation method thereof. The persulfate sustained-release material comprises persulfate pellets and a polylactic acid coating layer wrapping the persulfate pellets, the persulfate pellets are composed of persulfate and 2: 1 type layered clay minerals, the persulfate and the clay minerals are uniformly dispersed, and inorganic salt pore-forming particles are uniformly dispersed in the polylactic acid coating layer. The invention can realize long-term stable release of persulfate. The adopted raw materials are environment-friendly and proper-cost materials, have good chemical compatibility with an oxidizing agent, do not consume the oxidizing agent, and are not easy to generate secondary pollution.

column12: Delivery devices
column13: Disclosed herein are devices for use in transplanting cells. The devices can include a housing defining a cavity; and a support structure separating the cavity into a cell chamber and a reservoir chamber, wherein the support structure comprises a membrane for fluid communication between the cell chamber and reservoir chamber. The cell chamber can define a first opening comprising a microstructure containing an array of micro-channels, each having a diameter to facilitate growth of vascular tissues; and an array of micro-reservoirs, each having a diameter to facilitate housing of cell aggregates individually. The membrane can define a surface area that is at least 50% of a total surface area of the support structure. Methods of treating a subject for a disease condition, such as diabetes, are also disclosed.

column12: Method of corneal transplantation or corneal inlay implantation with cross-linking
column13: A method of corneal implantation with cross-linking is disclosed herein. In one or more embodiments, the method includes the steps of: (i) prior to implantation, treating an implant formed from donor corneal tissue or a tissue culture grown corneal stroma with a solution of sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS), Triton X-100, benzalkonium chloride (BAK), Igepal, genipin, 100% glycerol, or alcohol for making the implant acellular, and for killing any bacteria, viruses, or parasites prior to implantation; (ii) implanting the implant into a recipient cornea; (iii) applying laser energy to the implant so as to modify the refractive power of the implant while being monitored using a Shack-Hartmann wavefront system so as to achieve a desired refractive power for the implant; and (iv) applying a cross-linking solution and irradiating the implant to cross-link the implant to prevent an immune response to the implant and/or rejection of the implant by a patient.

column12: A GLUCOSE-SENSITIVE INSULIN-LOADED MICROPARTICLE
column13: The invention relates to a glucose-sensitive insulin-loaded microparticle comprising a polymeric porous matrix made of a biocompatible and biodegradable polymer, insulin granules encapsulated within the polymeric porous matrix, and a blood glucose sensor attached to a surface of the microparticle. In one embodiment, the biocompatible and biodegradable polymer is poly(lactic-co-glycolic) acid (PLGA) and the blood glucose sensor is glucose oxidase or phenylboronic acid. The invention also relates to the use of the glucose-sensitive insulin-loaded microparticle for the therapeutic treatment of diabetes and for controlling glucose levels in the blood of a subject in need thereof.

column12: Lacrimal ductule plug for slowly releasing olopatadine and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a lacrimal ductule plug capable of slowly releasing olopatadine. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) dispersing olopatadine or salt thereof, polylactic acid, chitosan and trilysine in a solvent, and uniformly mixing, wherein the mass ratio of olopatadine or salt thereof to polylactic acid to chitosan to trilysine is (0.1-3): (5-30): (10-50): (0.5-3); (2) carrying out cross-linking reaction at 30-40 DEG C for 10-25 hours, cooling and drying to obtain a mixture; and (3) carrying out plasma treatment on the mixture obtained in the step (2) for 20 seconds to 5 minutes under the pressure of less than 7 pa, and then curing and molding to obtain the lacrimal ductule plug for slowly releasing olopatadine. The olopatadine or the salt thereof, the polylactic acid, the chitosan and the trilysine are used as raw materials for cross-linking reaction, and then plasma treatment is adopted to prepare the olopatadine sustained-release lacrimal ductule plug, so that the frequency of using an anti-allergic drug can be reduced or the anti-allergic drug does not need to be used, and the olopatadine sustained-release lacrimal ductule plug is good in patient compliance, good in comfort, good in biocompatibility, short-term in degradation and free of toxic and side effects. The side effect is small, the water swelling performance is good, and falling is not prone to occurring.

column12: Absorbable implants for plastic surgery
column13: Absorbable implants for breast surgery that conform to the breast parenchyma and surrounding chest wall have been developed. These implants support newly lifted breast parenchyma, and/or a breast implant. The implants have mechanical properties sufficient to support a reconstructed breast, and allow the in-growth of tissue into the implant as it degrades. The implants have a strength retention profile allowing the support of the breast to be transitioned from the implant to regenerated host tissue, without significant loss of support. Three-dimensional implants for use in minimally invasive mastopexy/breast reconstruction procedures are also described, that confer shape to a patient's breast. These implants are self-reinforced, can be temporarily deformed, implanted in a suitably dissected tissue plane, and resume their preformed three-dimensional shape. The implants are preferably made from poly-4-hydroxybutyrate (P4HB) and copolymers thereof. The implants have suture pullout strengths that can resist the mechanical loads exerted on the reconstructed breast.

column12: Self-degradable biological membrane filler as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of wastewater treatment. The preparation method comprises the following steps: blending polylactic acid, a copolymerization modifier, a plasticizer, a heat stabilizer and a nucleating agent to obtain a polylactic acid base material; carrying out alkali washing on the polylactic acid base material to obtain a micro-nano material; dipping the micro-nano material in the polymer solution to obtain a composite material; and carrying out plasma grafting on the composite material to obtain the self-degradable biological membrane filler. The controllable release rate of the polylactic acid as the carbon source is realized by adjusting the ratio of the polylactic acid to the copolymerization modifier. A plurality of micro-nano-scale defects are formed on the surface of the alkali-washed polylactic acid base material, the specific surface area of the material is increased, hydrophilic groups are grafted through plasma bombardment, and the hydrophilicity of the biological membrane filler is improved. The biological membrane filler provided by the invention slowly releases and falls off an outer membrane in water, a high-activity biological membrane is also formed in an internal active region, and the surface of the filler is continuously updated, so that the microbial activity is kept to be increased at a high speed.

column12: Magnetically-responsive thermally-sensitive fluorescent micelle particle and preparation method therefor
column13: A magnetically-responsive thermally-sensitive fluorescent micelle particle and a preparation method therefor. In the method, N-isopropylacrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, polylactic acid, etc. are used as raw materials to synthesize a thermosensitive P(NIPAM-co-DMAM)-b-PLA triblock polymer; a dextran-magnetic lamellar composite hydroxide-fluorouracil magnetic sustained-release drug delivery system is assembled at the core of the thermosensitive micelle by simultaneous hydration and dialysis, so as to prepare a magnetically-responsive thermally-sensitive fluorescent micelle having magnetic response and temperature-sensitivity; and water-soluble near-infrared CdHgTe quantum dots (QD) are grafted onto the surface of the magnetically-responsive thermally-sensitive micelle layer using an electrostatic binding technique, so as to finally prepare DMF@TRM@QD fluorescent micellar particles having near-infrared fluorescence emission, magnetic targeting, and thermosensitive controlled-release properties. The product of the present invention features an appropriate LCST, a simple process, low costs, a high drug load, good water solubility, and high sol stability. The micellar particle has ideal thermosensitive properties, magnetic targeting properties, and fluorescent tracer functions, and has special application prospects in the fields of targeted tumor therapy and magnetically induced thermotherapy.

column12: Microneedle with precise and controllable pulse type drug release function and preparation method
column13: The invention discloses a microneedle with a precise and controllable pulse type drug release function and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: dropwise adding a tris (hydroxymethyl) aminomethane solution of polydopamine into a tris (hydroxymethyl) aminomethane solution of nano microspheres of polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer loaded with drug insulin; reacting under stirring to modify the surface of the polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer with polydopamine, and drying to obtain nano microspheres of the polydopamine-polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer loaded with drug insulin; dissolving the nano microspheres of the drug insulin-loaded polydopamine-polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer in a sodium alginate solution, putting into a microneedle mold, centrifuging, taking out the microneedle mold, dropwise adding a calcium chloride solution on the microneedle mold, and drying. The microneedle material prepared by the invention realizes controlled release of the drug insulin in the microneedle through an electric appliance in daily life, so that the life safety of a patient is greatly guaranteed.

column13: The invention discloses a polymer-based hydroxyapatite composite material loaded cefadroxil as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of biological material preparation. Wherein the used polymer-based hydroxyapatite composite material takes polylactic acid as a base material, chitosan as an excipient material and hydroxyapatite as an inorganic filler, has good mechanical properties, drug loading performance and biocompatibility, and can be used as a drug carrier after drug impregnation by adopting a supercritical carbon dioxide fluid technology. column12: Preparation process of leuprorelin acetate sustained-release microspheres for injection
column13: The invention provides a preparation process of leuprorelin acetate sustained-release microspheres for injection, which comprises the following steps: dissolving leuprorelin acetate in a gelatin solution, then adding a polylactic acid-dichloromethane solution, pumping into a shearing machine for shearing, adjusting the pump speed and shearing process conditions to prepare primary emulsion, and carrying out spray drying on the primary emulsion to obtain the leuprorelin acetate sustained-release microspheres for injection. Adding a lactide-glycolide copolymer into the primary emulsion, carrying out shearing high-speed emulsification, adjusting shearing process conditions to prepare a multiple emulsion, loading the multiple emulsion into a rotary evaporator, carrying out vacuum-pumping rotary curing, and adding a mannitol solution for freeze-drying to obtain the leuprorelin acetate sustained-release microspheres for injection. The prepared leuprorelin acetate sustained-release microspheres for injection are uniformly emulsified and dispersed, have stable dissolution and release trends, do not have obvious burst release, and lay a foundation for clinical application.

column12: ORAL DRUG DELIVERY DEVICE WITH EXPANDING ARMS
column13: The present disclosure provides a drug delivery device. The drug delivery device is taken orally by a patient, and then activates within the gastrointestinal (GI) tract of the patient. Upon activation, resilient arms within the drug delivery device expand and engage the GI tract walls. A driver then drives a plunger within the drug delivery device, pushing a drug through a channel in the resilient arms and through the GI tract walls of the patient. After a period of time, at least a portion of the drug delivery device dissolves and the drug delivery device passes through the GI tract.

column12: Collagenase modified PLGA (poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid)) microspheres and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to improvement of drug delivery efficiency in pathological fibrosis tissues, in particular to collagenase modified PLGA (poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid)) microspheres and a preparation method thereof. The technical problem to be solved by the invention is to provide a new choice for a collagen barrier of a drug permeating fibrotic tissue. According to the technical scheme, the preparation method of the collagenase modified PLGA microspheres comprises the following steps: co-dissolving medicine micro powder and a polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer (PLGA) to prepare microspheres; and then carrying out modification by using collagenase. The collagenase is fixed on the surface of the PLGA microsphere, so that the PLGA microsphere loaded with the medicine is helped to penetrate through a collagen barrier, the permeation of the medicine loaded in the microsphere in tissues is improved, and the treatment efficiency is greatly improved.

column12: Omeprazole enteric-coated pellet and preparation process thereof
column13: The invention provides an omeprazole enteric-coated pellet and a preparation process thereof. The preparation process comprises the following steps: mixing a modified polylactic acid solution and an ethyl cellulose aqueous dispersion, and stirring to obtain a slow-release protection solution; dissolving mannitol in purified water to obtain a mannitol solution; the preparation method comprises the following steps: dry-mixing omeprazole and microcrystalline cellulose, adding dimeticone, shearing, extruding and rounding to obtain pellet cores; the preparation method comprises the following steps: alternately spraying a sustained-release protective solution and a mannitol solution on a pellet core, drying to obtain a coated pellet core, dissolving hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose and talcum powder in purified water, stirring to obtain an enteric coating solution, spraying the enteric coating solution on the coated pellet core, and drying after spraying to obtain the omeprazole enteric pellet. By adopting the unique omeprazole enteric-coated pellet preparation process, the pellet has the advantages of large drug loading capacity, smooth and round appearance, no fine powder, no cracking, no broken pellet, good pellet formability, high yield, good in-vitro release degree, stable quality, simple production process and controllable product quality.

column12: Preparation method and application of modified rhizoma smilacis glabrae sustained-release material
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a modified rhizoma smilacis glabrae sustained-release material. column12: Sustained Release Formulations Using Non-Aqueous Emulsions
column13: Non-aqueous emulsion methods for producing polymeric or polymer-coated microparticles are provided. One method produces a sustained release microparticle composition by combining protein powder and a polymer into a hydrocarbon solvent to form a non-aqueous first solution and adding the first solution to a second solution, wherein the second solution comprises a fluorocarbon liquid and a fluorosurfactant to form a non-aqueous emulsion comprising multiple emulsion hydrocarbon droplets in the fluorocarbon liquid. The subsequent microparticle hardening process includes the steps of removing the hydrocarbon solvent from the formed emulsion droplets, which can be achieved through evaporation the hydrocarbon at ambient condition under stirring, or accelerated hardening through vacuum, or through adding hydrofluoroester into the fluorocarbon as a cosolvent. Removing the fluorocarbon liquid and washing with extra fluorocarbon liquid to isolate the sustained release microparticles, wherein the sustained release microparticles comprise one or more cores of protein and a cortex of polymer.

column12: Preservative film with intelligent microorganism self-inhibition effect and preparation method of preservative film
column13: The invention belongs to the field of antibacterial food packaging, and particularly relates to a preservative film with an intelligent microorganism self-inhibition effect and a preparation method of the preservative film. Porous polylactic acid nanofibers are modified with polyethyleneimine to obtain positively charged polyethyleneimine modified porous polylactic acid nanofibers, cinnamon essential oil is loaded through a physical adsorption method, then a pectin coating is assembled through electrostatic interaction, and the microorganism self-inhibition preservative packaging film capable of releasing the cinnamon essential oil through specific stimulation response of pectinase is obtained. column12: Preparation method and application of self-assembled fibroin/polylactic acid block-like copolymer for drug delivery
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a self-assembled fibroin/polylactic acid block-like copolymer for drug delivery. The preparation method comprises the following steps: adding degummed fibroin fibers into ionic liquid to obtain a silk fibroin solution; adding polylactic acid into N, N-dimethylformamide to be dissolved to obtain a polylactic acid solution; mixing and stirring the silk fibroin solution and the polylactic acid solution to obtain a uniform silk fibroin/polylactic acid solution; and freeze-drying the fibroin/polylactic acid solution, immersing the fibroin/polylactic acid solution in ethanol, solidifying the fibroin/polylactic acid solution in a self-assembly manner to form a hydrogel state, and carrying out drying to obtain a fibroin/polylactic acid composite material with characteristics similar to those of typical block copolymers. The unique block-like structure provided by the invention can be applied to inclusion and delivery of drugs through hydrophobic or electrostatic interaction. The preparation method disclosed by the invention is green and environment-friendly, is simple and convenient to operate, can regulate and control the form, the structure, the physical property and the biological property of the fibroin/polylactic acid composite material, and provides a new method and thought for a green production process of the biological composite material.

column12: Branched polyethylene glycol epoxy derivative crosslinked sodium hyaluronate gel, preparation and application thereof
column13: The present invention discloses a branched polyethylene glycol epoxy derivative crosslinked sodium hyaluronate gel, preparation and application thereof. The crosslinking agent used in the crosslinked sodium hyaluronate gel prepared by the present invention is a polyethylene glycol epoxy derivative, due to the existence of multiple ether bonds in the molecule of the crosslinking agent, there are more hydrogen bonds in the gel system; meanwhile, due to the particularity of the space structure of the branched polyethylene glycol epoxy derivative, the gel prepared has a more complex winding structure in its space, thus achieving better stability. Moreover, the branched polyethylene glycol epoxy derivative involved in the present invention is a compound with single molecular weight, therefore, the gel prepared thereby has better batch stability.

column12: Nano drug delivery system for treating eosinophilic asthma as well as preparation method and application of nano drug delivery system
column13: The invention relates to the field of nano-drugs, in particular to a nano drug delivery system for treating eosinophilic asthma as well as a preparation method and application of the nano drug delivery system. According to the nano drug delivery system, biotinylated polyethylene glycol-thioketal-polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer is used as a base material, drug-carrying nano particles carrying JAK2 inhibitor Fedratinib are self-assembled and synthesized by adopting an emulsification method, and then Fc fragments of immunoglobulin are modified on the nano particles, so that the nano drug delivery system is obtained. The nano drug delivery system is an ROS response-FcRn targeted micro-nano drug delivery system, and the system realizes lung cross-airway barrier drug delivery, prolongs the residence time of drugs in the lung, realizes responsive slow release in the lung, and improves the drug utilization and curative effect. A novel carrier and a preparation method thereof are provided for treatment of eosinophilic asthma and lung diseases similar to eosinophilic asthma.

column12: Interferon alpha-2b sustained-release oral patch and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention provides an interferon alpha-2b sustained-release oral patch and a preparation method thereof. Nanoparticles are prepared by adopting a multiple emulsion-solvent evaporation method or reduced pressure distillation, and freeze-dried powder of the nanoparticles and auxiliary materials are pressed into the oral patch. A polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer (PLGA) is used as a nano-particle carrier, and interferon alpha-2b is wrapped inside, so that the stability of the interferon alpha-2b is improved, the slow release of the interferon alpha-2b can be controlled, and the half-life period of plasma can be prolonged. The prepared nanoparticles are round and normal, uniform in dispersion, stable in property and good in resolubility after being freeze-dried, in-vitro release is in conformity with the characteristics of a long-acting preparation, the particle size is mainly distributed within a range of 50-1,000 nm, the in-vivo half-life period is prolonged to 120-600 h, the encapsulation efficiency is about 70%-90%, and the drug loading capacity of the interferon alpha-2b sustained-release oral patch is 8-45 <mu>g. The nanoparticles are freeze-dried and then are uniformly mixed with the auxiliary materials such as hydroxypropyl methylcellulose, sodium carboxymethyl cellulose, carbomer, magnesium stearate and the like, the mixture is pressed into tablets, and the tablets can be applied to sustained-release administration of oral patches.

column12: Polylactic acid polycarbonate-based polyurethane with self-repairing function as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of marine antifouling, and relates to a polylactic acid polycarbonate-based polyurethane substrate material with a self-repairing function as well as a preparation method and application of the polylactic acid polycarbonate-based polyurethane substrate material. The invention relates to polylactic acid polycarbonate-based polyurethane with a self-repairing function. A soft segment component of the polylactic acid polycarbonate-based polyurethane is dihydroxyl-terminated polylactic acid polycarbonate polymer macromolecular dihydric alcohol; the hard segment component is any one of benzhydryl diisocyanate, isophorone diisocyanate and 1, 6-hexyl diisocyanate; The polylactic acid polycarbonate-based polyurethane substrate material with the self-repairing function can be used for preparing a self-repairing bionic super-smooth coating and a self-repairing marine antifouling coating with an antifouling agent temperature-sensitive controlled release function, and the self-repairing function and the antifouling agent temperature-sensitive controlled release function endow the coating with longer biological fouling prevention and treatment performance. Meanwhile, the preparation methods of the polylactic acid polycarbonate-based polyurethane material and the coating are simple, and the reaction conditions are mild and efficient.

column13: Methods and compositions for treating prostate cancer are described herein. column12: Biodegradable controlled-release long-acting implant tablet and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to a biodegradable controlled-release long-acting implant tablet and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of medicines, the biodegradable controlled-release long-acting implant tablet is composed of levonorgestrel, a polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer and polycaprolactone; the preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing microspheres with a particle size of 3 [mu] m by an emulsification-solvent evaporation method, and preparing the implant tablet with a diameter of 6 mm by adopting direct tabletting and controlled-release film coating. The levonorgestrel sustained-release microsphere has the advantages that levonorgestrel is slowly released at a constant rate by the aid of sustained-release characteristics of the microsphere and controlled-release characteristics of the controlled-release membrane, the drug release time can reach 90 days, the levonorgestrel sustained-release microsphere has good biocompatibility and biodegradability after clinical administration, carrier materials do not need to be taken out by secondary operations, and the levonorgestrel sustained-release microsphere is stable in in-vivo blood concentration and few in adverse reaction.

column12: Cannabidiol nano analgesic patch taking bacterial cellulose-magnetic graphene oxide as base material and preparation method of cannabidiol nano analgesic patch
column13: The invention discloses a cannabidiol nano analgesic patch taking bacterial cellulose-magnetic graphene oxide as a base material. The patch comprises a degradable backing layer, a degradable adhesive layer coated on the surface of the degradable backing layer, a nano magnetic graphene oxide composite sustained-release drug gel layer coated on the surface of the degradable adhesive layer, and a bacterial cellulose quick-release drug gel layer coated on the surface of the nano magnetic graphene oxide composite sustained-release drug gel layer. The invention further discloses a preparation method of the cannabidiol nano analgesic patch with the bacterial cellulose-magnetic graphene oxide as the base material. The nano bacterial cellulose degradable material and the nano magnetic graphene oxide are used as patch base materials, the polylactic acid polyester biodegradable material is used as the backing layer, the environment is protected, pollution is avoided, and the dual effects of easing pain and resisting inflammation are achieved.

column12: Oxygen sustained-release material as well as preparation method and medicine thereof
column13: The invention discloses an oxygen sustained-release material, a preparation method and a medicine thereof, the oxygen sustained-release material is a microsphere, the microsphere comprises a degradable biological material and peroxide dispersed in the degradable biological material, and the degradable biological material is polycaprolactone (PCL) or a mixed material of polycaprolactone and polylactic acid (PLA). According to the invention, polycaprolactone or a mixed material of polycaprolactone and polylactic acid is used as a degradable material matrix; the degradation rate is proper, and the continuity and total amount of oxygen release can be well controlled; the formed oxygen sustained-release material can provide oxygen support for a long time when being subsequently mixed with a cell therapeutic agent to form a medicine for use. The cell therapeutic agent can be effectively prevented from death caused by hypoxia, the effect of the cell therapeutic agent is promoted, and the invention has a relatively good application prospect.
