column12: Preparation method of phosphorene-functional-modified 3D-print polylactic acid bionic nanofiber support
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a phosphorene-functional-modified 3D-print polylactic acid bionic nanofiber support and aims to provide a multifunctional support material for repairing bone defects and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method is characterized by comprising the following steps: loading an anti-inflammatory drug ibuprofen onto nano flaky phosphorene prepared by a liquid-phase stripping method, and coating the surface of the phosphorene with a polydopamine coating, so as to realize intelligent controlled release of the drug; and uniformly doping the obtained drug-loaded phosphorene into an amination-modified polylactic acid matrix to obtain a size mixture, constructing a personalized support by adopting a low-temperature 3D printing technology, and enabling the support to be subjected to phase separation under a low-temperature printing condition so as to form a reticular nanofiber structure of a bionic extracellular matrix. The preparation method has the characteristics that the prepared support can be subjected to personalized designing according to characteristics of a bone defect part of a patient, and the prepared support has good actions of cellular affinity, photothermal conversion performance, bone growth promotion, intelligent drug release and long-acting inflammation resisting and has potential application prospects in the field of bone tissue engineering.

column12: Solvent precipitation type in-situ gel injection implant and application
column13: The invention mainly provides a solvent precipitation type in-situ gel implant with a self-assembly characteristic of a stereocomplex polylactic acid crystal. After the in-situ gel implant encounters water or is injected into a human body, a solid implant containing stereocomplex polylactic acid crystals is spontaneously formed under the action of polymer precipitation initiated by solvent exchange. column12: Dressing capable of monitoring drug delivery and used for wound repair and preparation method of dressing
column13: The invention discloses a dressing capable of monitoring drug delivery and used for wound repair and a preparation method of the dressing. The film capable of monitoring drug delivery is good in biocompatibility, internally provided with mutually-communicating nano-pore structures and capable of loading chitosan and vascular endothelial growth factors; and due to the neatly arranged pores, the film has a photonic band gap, natural light with specific wavelength and frequency is prevented from penetrating and the part of light is completely reflected to form a characteristic reflection peak, and the characteristic reflection peak moves in a drug release process, so the function of monitoring drug release is achieved. column12: Novel kidney-targeted nano drug delivery system with biomimetic modification of erythrocyte membrane as well as preparation method and application of novel kidney-targeted nano drug delivery system
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, and particularly relates to a novel kidney-targeted nano drug delivery system with biomimetic modification of an erythrocyte membrane as well as a preparation method and application of the novel kidney-targeted nano drug delivery system. According to the application, polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer (PLGA) is taken as a carrier material, prednisolone acetate (PA) is taken as a model drug, and a novel bionic nano drug delivery system (RBC-PA-NPs) with kidney targeting is constructed by utilizing a strategy of coating an erythrocyte membrane on the surface. The drug delivery system combines the biocompatibility of the erythrocyte membrane and the targeting property of the nanoparticles, so that the kidney targeting property of PA is improved, and the glomerulonephritis is treated more effectively. Therefore, evaluation is carried out from the aspects of a preparation process, physicochemical properties, cytotoxicity and uptake, in-vivo targeting and the like of the drug delivery system.

column12: IMPLANTABLE SUSTAINED-RELEASE MICRONEEDLE PATCH AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR
column13: An implantable sustained-release microneedle patch and a preparation method therefor. The implantable sustained-release microneedle comprises a needle tip, a needle body, and a base. The needle tip comprises a needle tip center layer and a needle tip outer layer. The needle tip center layer is formed of a matrix comprising a biodegradable water-insoluble polymer material. The needle tip outer layer, the needle body, and the base are formed of a matrix comprising a water-soluble polymer material. The microneedle patch comprises the microneedle and absorbs the moisture of the skin when the microneedle acts on skin, so that the base and the needle body are quickly separated from the needle tip within 0.5-2 h. After the base is removed, the needle tip will be left in skin, and the user does not need the patch sticking for a long time to ensure long-term release of a drug in the body.

column12: DRUG DELIVERY DEVICES HAVING SEPARABLE MICRONEEDLES AND METHODS
column13: Drug delivery devices and methods are provided for delivering one or more drugs into a biological tissue. When the microneedles are separable, a force applied to the drug delivery devices may be effective to penetrate a biological tissue with the microneedles and then to separate the microneedles from the drug delivery devices. The drug delivery devices may be capable of achieving discrete periods of drug release. Methods for delivery drug with microneedles also are provided.

column12: Fibroin polylactic acid porous nanofiber composite material as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a fibroin polylactic acid porous nanofiber composite material and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: cutting cocoon shells into pieces to be subjected to degumming treatment, adding degummed domestic silkworm silk into a calcium chloride/formic acid solution to obtain a domestic silkworm silk protein solution, filtering the domestic silkworm silk protein solution, adding filtrate into a polylactic acid solution to be evenly mixed, and performing ultrasonic treatment; and performing electrospinning treatment on a fibroin polylactic acid solution subjected to ultrasonic treatment to obtain the fibroin polylactic acid porous nanofiber composite material. The preparation process is convenient to operate, low in production cost, short in production period and environmentally friendly, the prepared fibroin polylactic acid composite nanofiber membrane has a specific fiber morphology, and a specific hole structure and a secondary structure exist on a single fiber, and thus the requirements for different properties of materials are met; The fibroin polylactic acid porous nanofiber composite material can be applied to wound dressings, tissue engineering scaffold materials, and drug delivery and transfer materials.

column12: Preparation method of double-loading pesticide nano microcapsule suspending agent
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a double-loading pesticide nano microcapsule suspending agent. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, diluting chlorantraniliprole raw medicine with deionized water, then adding polyvinyl alcohol and bovine serum albumin, and dissolving as a solid phase (S); diluting lambda-cyhalothrin with dichloromethane, adding polylactic acid, and dissolving to obtain an oil phase (O); diluting polyvinyl alcohol with deionized water to serve as an outer water phase (W); slowly pouring the solid phase S into an oil phase under high-speed shearing, shearing for one minute to form a water-in-oil primary emulsion, and carrying out ultrasonic emulsification on the obtained primary emulsion at certain power for three minutes to obtain a double-loading multiple emulsion system; and centrifuging for 10 minutes at a high speed of 10000 rpm for three times, discarding the supernate after each centrifugation, supplementing the same amount of deionized water for complete dispersion, and finally volatilizing at room temperature for 24 hours to obtain the double-loading pesticide nano microcapsule suspending agent. According to the method disclosed by the invention, the compounding power of different soluble pesticides is improved, and slow controlled release of the two pesticides is realized at the same time.

column12: Magnetically-responsive thermally-sensitive fluorescent micelle particle and preparation method therefor
column13: A magnetically-responsive thermally-sensitive fluorescent micelle particle and a preparation method therefor. In the method, N-isopropylacrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, polylactic acid, etc. are used as raw materials to synthesize a thermosensitive P(NIPAM-co-DMAM)-b-PLA triblock polymer; a dextran-magnetic lamellar composite hydroxide-fluorouracil magnetic sustained-release drug delivery system is assembled at the core of the thermosensitive micelle by simultaneous hydration and dialysis, so as to prepare a magnetically-responsive thermally-sensitive fluorescent micelle having magnetic response and temperature-sensitivity; and water-soluble near-infrared CdHgTe quantum dots (QD) are grafted onto the surface of the magnetically-responsive thermally-sensitive micelle layer using an electrostatic binding technique, so as to finally prepare DMF@TRM@QD fluorescent micellar particles having near-infrared fluorescence emission, magnetic targeting, and thermosensitive controlled-release properties. The product of the present invention features an appropriate LCST, a simple process, low costs, a high drug load, good water solubility, and high sol stability. The micellar particle has ideal thermosensitive properties, magnetic targeting properties, and fluorescent tracer functions, and has special application prospects in the fields of targeted tumor therapy and magnetically induced thermotherapy.

The injectable composite carrier is composed of a polymer and an adjuvant, wherein the polymer comprises one or more than two of PLA-PEG-PLA (polylactic acid-polyethylene glycol-polylactic acid), PLGA-PEG-PLGA (poly lactic-co-glycolic acid-polyethylene glycol-poly lactic-co-glycolic acid), PEG-PLA-PEG, PEG-PLGA-PEG, PEG-PLGA, PEG-PLA, PLGA and PLA; the adjuvant contains one or more than two of low-molecular-weight polyethylene glycol, vegetable oil and triglyceride. The injectable composite carrier does not contain water or toxic micromolecular organic solvents, is suitable for being used as the carrier for providing sustained and controlled release and long-acting effects for various types of drugs, and is wide in application range. The composition is composed of the injectable composite carrier and a drug, wherein the drug accounts for 0.01%-60.0% of the composition in percentage by weight. The composition can realize controllable slow release of the drug. The injectable composite carrier and the composition are simple in preparationprocess, the products are easy to obtain, and industrial large-scale production is facilitated.

column12: DEGRADABLE VASCULAR STENT CAPABLE OF AVOIDING LATE RESTENOSIS
column13: The present invention relates to a degradable vascular stent capable of avoiding late restenosis, comprising a base region (111a, 111b, 111c, 111d, 111e, 111f, 111g, 111h, 111i) formed by a polylactic acid based polymer; at least one storage region (112a, 112b, 112c, 112d, 112e, 112f, 112g, 112h, 112i) in which an active agent is stored; and an outer layer of a drug sustained release coating (12a, 12b, 12c, 12d, 12e, 12f, 12g, 12h, 12i) covered on the base region (111a, 111b, 111c, 111d, 111e, 111f, 111g, 111h, 111i) and/or the storage region (112a, 112b, 112c, 112d, 112e, 112f, 112g, 112h, 112i). Before the mass of the polylactic acid based polymer of the base region (111a, 111b, 111c, 111d, 111e, 111f, 111g, 111h, 111i) is decreased by 10-20%, the active agent in the storage region (112a, 112b, 112c, 112d, 112e, 112f, 112g, 112h, 112i) is retained in structural units of the polylactic acid based polymer. After the mass of the polylactic acid based polymer of the base region (111a, 111b, 111c, 111d, 111e, 111f, 111g, 111h, 111i) is decreased by 10-20%, the active agent in the storage region (112a, 112b, 112c, 112d, 112e, 112f, 112g, 112h, 112i) is released from the storage region (112a, 112b, 112c, 112d, 112e, 112f, 112g, 112h, 112i). According to the degradable vascular stent capable of avoiding late restenosis, the base region (111a, 111b, 111c, 111d, 111e, 111f, 111g, 111h, 111i) serves as a main body to mainly provide a supporting capacity for ensuring the patency of blood vessels; the drug sustained release coating (12a, 12b, 12c, 12d, 12e, 12f, 12g, 12h, 12i) covered on the base region is used for drug release in an early stage after implantation; and the active agent stored in storage region (112a, 112b, 112c, 112d, 112e, 112f, 112g, 112h, 112i) only works in late degradation of the stent to avoid late restenosis.

column12: Plastic injection material and injection method thereof
column13: The invention provides a modified poly-L-lactic acid plastic material, a plastic injection material and an injection method of the plastic injection material. The modified poly-L-lactic acid plastic material is prepared by performing copolymerization of poly(2-hydroxysuccinic acid) with L-polylactic acid to obtainmodified L-polylactic acid; and then mixing the modified poly-L-lactic acid with sodium hyaluronate and mannitol. The material has strong hydrophilicity, low crystallinity and strong flexibility, and can avoid problems of nodules, redness and swelling and the like after injection. Meanwhile, a coaxial double-layer injection method is adopted, injection of a solution A formed by mixing milk protein cellulose and viscose cellulose and a filler solution B prepared from the modified L-polylactic acid plastic material is conducted on the basis of different speeds at the same time to form a double-layer structure to achieve a sustained release effect and prevent rapid absorption ofL-polylactic acid by the skin, ensure that the skin fully and completely utilize L-polylactic acid, and greatly reduce cost , and save the use of materials.

The implants are preferably made from poly-4-hydroxybutyrate (P4HB) and copolymers thereof. The implants have suture pullout strengths that can resist the mechanical loads exerted on the reconstructed breast.

column13: The invention discloses a preparation method for a material for a traditional Chinese medicine bacteriostatic face mask, and belongs to the technical field of face mask materials. column12: Preparation method of polylactic acid nano microspheres
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of polylactic acid nano microspheres. The method comprises the following steps: adding PLA into dichloromethane to form an organic phase; adding a surfactant Tween20 into ultrapure water, and performing heating, stirring and dissolving at 44-46 DEG C to obtain a water phase; slowly dropwise adding the organic phase into the water phase under a stirringcondition, performing ultrasonic emulsification for 15-25 minutes after uniform stirring, performing magnetic stirring at 25-35 DEG C for 23-25 hours to completely volatilize an organic solvent, centrifugally collecting microspheres, repeatedly washing the microspheres with ultrapure water to remove the surfactant, and performing vacuum freeze drying to obtain the product. The method is simple, convenient, quick and easy to operate. The prepared polylactic acid nano microspheres have good dispersibility and balling property, and can be used as a carrier to realize targeted controlled release of drugs.

column12: Nanolipogel vehicles for controlled delivery of different pharmaceutical agents
column13: A “nanolipogel” is a delivery vehicle including one or more lipid layer surrounding a hydrogel core, which may include an absorbent such as a cyclodextrin or ion-exchange resin. Nanolipogels can be constructed so as to incorporate a variety of different chemical entities that can subsequently be released in a controlled fashion. These different incorporated chemical entities can differ dramatically with respect to size and composition. Nanolipogels have been constructed to contain co-encapsulated proteins as well as small hydrophobic drugs within the interior of the lipid bilayer. Agents incorporated within nanolipogels can be released into the milieu in a controlled fashion, for example, nanolipogels provide a means of achieving simultaneous sustained release of agents that differ widely in chemical composition and molecular weight. Additionally, nanolipogels can favorably modulate biodistribution.

column12: Preparation method of novel biodegradable high-barrier packaging film
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a novel biodegradable high-barrier packaging film. The method comprises the following steps: preparing a konjac glucomannan solution with the concentration of 0.5-0.8% (w/v) by taking water as a solvent; preparing a glutelin solution with the concentration of 1-5% (w/v) from a 55% ethanol solution with the pH value of 12; preparing a polylactic acidsolution with the concentration of 0.1-15% (w/v) by taking dichloromethane as a solvent; blending the konjac glucomannan solution, the glutelin solution and the polylactic acid solution according to different proportions, carrying out gradient heating to form a konjac glucomannan/glutelin/polylactic acid mixed solution, and carrying out tape casting to form a film, thereby obtaining the novel biodegradable high-barrier packaging film. The film prepared according to the method is flat and smooth and has good mechanical properties and water resistance and can be naturally and quickly degraded and can be used as a packaging film material, daily chemical industry and a sustained-release material and the like and has a wide application prospect.

column12: Protein-containing collagen-based bone repair material
column13: The invention discloses a protein-containing collagen-based bone repair material. The protein-containing collagen-based bone repair material comprises a bone repair material main body, a graphene oxide-polypyrrole self-assembled layer, and bone morphogenetic protein-2 immobilized on the self-assembled layer, wherein the bone repair material main body is composed of mesoporous hydroxyapatite, modified medical stone, a polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer and type I collagen. The used raw materials are non-toxic and harmless; good biocompatibility and excellent mechanical properties are achieved; the degradation speed of the materials is relatively consistent with the bone defect repair speed; relatively high osteogenesis activity is achieved; a bone morphogenetic protein-2 controllable release system is formed, burst release or release failure is avoided, the utilization rate of bone morphogenetic protein-2 is increased, and at the same time, complications caused by too high concentration of bone morphogenetic protein-2 are avoided.

column12: Drug delivery system with tumor microenvironment adjustment and targeting function and application thereof in pharmacy
column13: The invention belongs to the field of screening of effective components of traditional Chinese medicines and preparations of the effective components, and relates to a drug delivery system with tumormicroenvironment adjustment and a targeting function and application thereof in pharmacy, in particular to application in pancreatic tumor treatment. The invention discloses a nano delivery system. Nanoparticles which are constructed from a medical polymer polylactic acid material, have good biocompatibility and biodegradability and have the effects of regulating a tumor microenvironment and increasing blood perfusion are adopted, a section of functional polypeptide CGKRK is covalently bonded to the surface, the CGKRK can target heparan sulfate which is highly-expressed in the tumor microenvironment, and the tumor targeting property is improved; and natural drug monomers are physically entrapped in hydrophobic cores of the nanoparticles through an emulsifying solvent evaporation method, sothat the solubility of the drug is improved, and the in-vivo circulation time of the drug is prolonged. The established drug-loaded nano system can inhibit the excessive activation of CAFs, reduce the proportion of M2 macrophages, effectively improve the tumor microenvironment and increase the accumulation of the drug at the tumor site.

column12: Polylactic acid packaging film with controlled-release antioxidant activity and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a polylactic acid packaging film with controlled-release antioxidant activity. The polylactic acid packaging film comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 80-98% of matrix resin and 2-20% of natural antioxidant-loaded multi-walled carbon nanotube particles. The polylactic acid packaging film is prepared by loading a natural antioxidant onto a multi-walled carbon nanotube, then mixing the natural antioxidant-loaded multi-walled carbon nanotube with the matrix resin, and carrying out extrusion by adopting a melt extrusion method, wherein the matrix resinis a blend of polylactic acid and poly trimethylene carbonate. According to the invention, raw materials used in a preparation method can be biodegraded, and production process is simple; the multi-walled carbon nanotube is used for loading the natural antioxidant, and slow release of the natural antioxidant can be effectively controlled, so the timeliness of the antioxidant effect of the packaging film is improved; and the packaging film can be applied to the field of active antioxidant packaging of food.

column12: Graphene transdermal drug delivery microneedle
column13: The invention provides a graphene transdermal drug delivery microneedle. A base material of the microneedle is an organic high-molecular polymer which is used in pharmacy and has biocompatibility. A graphene material is uniformly dispersed in the organic high-molecular polymer, the organic high-molecular polymer is one of polyvinylpyrrolidone, polyvinyl alcohol, hyaluronic acid, a polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer and carboxymethyl cellulose, and the graphene material is graphene or graphene treated by chemical and physical methods. The graphene transdermal drug delivery microneedle disclosed by the invention has good mechanical properties, so that the microneedle can easily penetrate through the cuticle. The graphene transdermal drug delivery microneedle disclosed by the invention has good capability of controlling drug release, and can control drug release in an infrared light manner. The graphene transdermal drug delivery microneedle disclosed by the invention has excellent antibacterial performances, so that the microneedle is easy to store. The preparation method of the graphene transdermal drug delivery microneedle is simple and low in cost.

column12: Preparation method of medicine controlled-release type polylactic acid based bone repair bracket material
column13: The invention relates to a preparation method of a medicine controlled-release type polylactic acid based bone repair bracket material, and belongs to the field of a biology biocompatible material. The preparation method comprises the steps of respectively maintaining a polylactic acid solution to a total air temperature metal bath of 15 DEG C, 25 DEG C and 35 DEG C for 10min for treatment, pouring the treated solution in a precooled mould, performing quick freezing at minus 20 DEG C for 2h, after thorough consolidation, performing placing in a freeze drying machine, and performing drying for24h. Quick freezing is controlled to different initial temperatures, and the course of crystallization of the polylactic acid is controlled, so that controlled release of Vancomycin drugs by the bonerepair bracket materials is realized. When the polylactic acid solution is shaped at 15-35 DEG C, modulus of elasticity is sequentially reduced. In the preparation process, ossification active components of collagen/hydroxyapatite and silk fibroin, hydroxyapatite and the like can be respectively compounded with the polylactic acid, the materials have the components for imitating human bones and porous structures. The bone repair material prepared by the method for imitating the human bone components and structure is hopeful to be broadly applied to clinical treatment of orthopaedics.

column12: Paliperidone implant and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a paliperidone implant, and further provides a preparation method of the paliperidone implant. The paliperidone implant is prepared from a therapeutically effective amount of paliperidone active ingredients and pharmaceutically acceptable biodegradable materials serving as a carrier. The paliperidone active ingredient is pharmaceutically acceptable salts of nano-scale paliperidone, and the biodegradable materials are polylactic acid and chitosan. The preparation method of the paliperidone implant includes the steps that S1, the nano-scale paliperidone active ingredientsare prepared; S2, paliperidone microspheres are prepared; S3, tabletting is performed, specifically, the paliperidone microspheres obtained in the step S2 and the nano-scale paliperidone active ingredients obtained in the step S1 are heated and subjected to tabletting to obtain paliperidone implant tablets; and S4, capsule coating is performed. The paliperidone implant has a long sustained release time and good drug release completeness, and can effectively improve the drug compliance of patients and ensure the treatment effect; and meanwhile, according to the preparation method, the productstability is good, and technical support is provided for the commercial application of the paliperidone implant.

column12: Isotactic polylactic acid porous microspheres and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to isotactic polylactic acid porous microspheres and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing: dissolving PLLA and PDLA in adimethyl series solvent at the temperature of T1 to obtain a polylactic acid solution; cooling the polylactic acid solution to a temperature T2 at a rate of 0.5-10 DEG C/min to obtain the isotactic polylactic acid porous microspheres, wherein T1 is greater than or equal to 50 DEG C, T2 is less than or equal to 25 DEG C, and the dimethyl series solvent is DMF, DMSO or DMAc. The finally prepared isotactic polylactic acid porous microspheres are polylactic acid microspheres of isotactic crystal forms and porous structures. The preparation method of the isotactic polylactic acid porous microspheres is simple and easy to implement and low in cost, and the solvent can be recycled and separated for use; the polylactic acid porous microsphere prepared by the method is wide in application range, and can be used as a drug controlled-release material, a cell carrier, cosmetics, plastics, a coating additive and the like.

column12: Preparation of amphiphilic polyurethane copolymer with photoresponse and reduction response
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of an amphiphilic linear polyurethane block copolymer with photoresponse and reduction response at the same time. The preparation method includes: subjecting isophorone diisocyanate, hydrophobic polylactic acid and 5-hydroxyl-2-nitrobenzyl alcohol to one-pot reaction to prepare a prepolymer, and then adding hydrophilic polyethylene glycol monomethoxy ether for reaction to obtain the amphiphilic linear polyurethane block copolymer. The method for preparation of the novel drug-loading material is simple, bonds group with reduction response and photoresponse into the amphiphili polymer, and has wide prospects in the field of controlled release of drugs.

column12: Methods and compositions particularly for treatment of attention deficit disorder
column13: There is described, inter alia, a coated bead comprising: (a) a granule; (b) a first layer coated over the granule, the first layer comprising a first amount of an active pharmaceutical ingredient comprising a central nervous system stimulant; and (c) a second layer coated over the first layer, the second layer being present in an amount sufficient to substantially delay release of the active pharmaceutical ingredient in the first layer until after the coated bead reaches a distal intestine portion of a subject to whom the coated bead is administered; and (d) the third layer coated over the second layer, the third layer comprising a second amount of the active pharmaceutical ingredient, the third layer being configured to permit substantially immediate release of the active pharmaceutical ingredient comprised therein. Embodiments related to a solid oral pharmaceutical composition are also described.

column12: Preparation and application of F3 polypeptide-oriented PAMAM-core tumor drug nanocarrier
column13: The present invention discloses a preparation and an application of a F3 polypeptide-oriented PAMAM-core tumor drug nanocarrier. A dendrimer compound polyamide-amine (PAMAM) is used as a nano drug carrier core, a hydrophobic chain polylactic acid (PLA) is used to be covalently connected with surfaces of the core as an inner shell, then a hydrophilic chain polyethylene glycol (PEG) is connected asan outer shell, F3 polypeptides are connected on the PEG outer shell as a target ligand to realize tumor targeting of a system, and a hydrophobic antitumor drug docetaxel (DTX) is loaded into the hydrophobic core and inner shell of the nano drug carrier in a physically embedding manner. The prepared nano drug carrier has good biocompatibility, can significantly improve solubility of the DTX, and has potential clinical application value.

column12: Preparation of amphipathic targeted nano-drug delivery system based on carboxylated cellulose
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of an amphipathic targeted nano-drug delivery system based on carboxylated cellulose. The preparation method of the amphipathic targeted nano-drug deliverysystem based on the carboxylated cellulose comprises the steps that the carboxylated cellulose is grafted onto polylactic acid through an open-loop polymerization method; an obtained grafted copolymer is in key connection with targeted molecule folic acid through amide; and anti-tumor drug ursolic acid is wrapped with a folic acid-carboxylated nano cellulose-polylactic acid in water in a self-assembly mode to obtain a nano-drug particle. The nano-drug particle has a bilayer structure, and an amphipathic shell is the folic acid-carboxylated nano cellulose; and an inner layer is hydrophobic molecule polylactic acid and the anti-tumor drug ursolic acid. The preparation method of the amphipathic targeted nano-drug delivery system based on the carboxylated cellulose has the advantages that thenano-drug delivery system increases water solubility and stability of the anti-tumor drug ursolic acid, and drug loading capacity is greatly improved; folic acid is connected to enhance the targetedaction of drugs on tumor sites; a nano-drug carrier has good spheronization performance, and grain sizes are uniform; and the preparation technology is simple and easy to operate.

column12: ANTI-CANCER AND DISINTEGRIN SCORPION VENOMS
column13: The invention is related to novel scorpion venoms and methods of using the same in various treatment applications, including, but not limited to inhibiting cell migration, cell proliferation, and angiogenesis, as well as to treat cancer, pathological angiogenesis, and integrin-mediated diseases. The invention encompasses a short 14 amino acid peptide (calledRK1), purified from the venom of Buthus occitanus tunetanus, with the particular capabilities,among different other scorpion peptides, to inhibit cell proliferation, migration and angiogenesis of U87 (Glioblastoma) and IGR39 (Melanoma). Moreover, RK1 is a first peptide derived from scorpion venom exhibiting a potential anti-tumoral activity with no manifest toxicity.

column12: Polylactic acid/polycaprolactone three-dimensional porous composite monolithic column material and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention provides a polylactic acid/polycaprolactone three-dimensional porous composite monolithic column material and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the followingsteps: dissolving a certain amount of polylactic acid and polycaprolactone into a good solvent of the polylactic acid and the polycaprolactone; adding a certain amount of a poor solvent into the polylactic acid/polycaprolactone mixed solution to a cloud point to make the system change from a steady state to a metastable state; allowing the metastable-state system to stand until the polylactic acid/polycaprolactone solution spontaneously forms a three-dimensional pass-through porous structure to obtain a wet bulk material; and performing replacement, performing vacuum low-pressure drying to make the polylactic acid/polycaprolactone solidified to form the porous composite monolithic column material. The three-dimensional porous composite monolithic column material prepared by the technicalsolution provided by the invention has the advantages of excellent rapid mass transfer performance and chemical stability, a large specific surface area, easy chemical modification, no toxicity and biodegradability, meets the requirements of ecology and environment protection, and can be widely used in the fields of oil absorption, biomedical applications, drug controlled release, catalyst carriers, tissue engineering and the like.

column12: Zinc alloy vascular stent material having ultra-high-flexible coating layer with drug sustained-release function
column13: The present invention discloses a zinc alloy vascular stent material having an ultra-high-flexible coating layer with a drug sustained-release function, and a preparation method thereof. column12: VEHICLES FOR CONTROLLED DELIVERY OF DIFFERENT PHARMACEUTICAL AGENTS
column13: A "nanolipogel" is a delivery vehicle including one or more lipid layer surrounding a hydrogel core, which may include an absorbent such as a cyclodextrin or ion-exchange resin. Nanolipogels can be constructed so as to incorporate a variety of different chemical entities that can subsequently be released in a controlled fashion. These different incorporated chemical entities can differ dramatically with respect to size and composition. Nanolipogels have been constructed to contain co-encapsulated proteins as well as small hydrophobic drugs within the interior of the lipid bilayer. Agents incorporated within nanolipogels can be released into the milieu in a controlled fashion, for example, nanolipogels provide a means of achieving simultaneous sustained release of agents that differ widely in chemical composition and molecular weight. Additionally, nanolipogels can favorably modulate biodistribution.

column12: Degradable drug-loaded controlled-release myocardial repair patch with multilevel structure
column13: The invention belongs to the field of medical instruments and myocardial repair, and particularly relates to a degradable drug-loaded controlled-release myocardial repair patch with a multilevel structure and a preparation method thereof. The basis material of the myocardial repair patch is a mixture of L-polylactic acid/polyethyllactone (PLLA/PCL), the loaded medicine is vascular endothelial growth factor/basic fibroblast growth factor (VEGF/ bFGF), the myocardial repair patch has conductive characteristics, the surface of the myocardial repair patch is coated with dopamine, and the carrier fiber has orientation and has a micro-groove or micro-pore structure. The preparation process of the present invention includes the following steps: (1) blending VEGF/bFGF, polypyrrole/metal particlesand PLLA/ PCL in a mild solvent, and preparing the myocardial repair patch by using ultrasonic emulsification and a multi-fluid oriented electrostatic spinning technology at room temperature; (2) carving the surface of the prepared myocardial repair patch by using a laser carving technology to prepare a multilevel structure, and (3) coating the surface of the myocardial repair patch with polydopamine so as to facilitate tissue adhesion.

column12: Porous polymer material, preparation method therefor, and biomaterial using same
column13: The present invention relates to: a porous polymer material having a porous structure over the entire polymer and having a dense porous structure in which pores are connected to each other therein. The porous polymer material is harmless to the human body as it does not use toxic organic solvents. In addition, a porous polymer material can be prepared without using any additives for forming pores and the particle size can be easily controlled, and thus a polymer material suitable for various uses can be prepared. Furthermore, the extended release of a loaded bioactive material is possible only by the dense porous structure of a polymer itself without using an additive and a surface modification method in the porous polymer material of the present invention. Therefore, the porous polymer material can be applied to a biodegradable material in various bio-fields requiring the extended release of a bioactive material.

column13: A drug delivery implant and a method of using the same are disclosed herein. column12: Selenium-rich bio-organic fertilizer and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a selenium-rich bio-organic fertilizer and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of fertilizers, wherein the selenium-rich bio-organic fertilizer isprepared by using livestock and poultry manure, lees residue, furfural residue, diatomaceous earth, a compound microbial agent, a soil conditioner, sodium selenite, polylactic acid/glycolic acid nanometer microspheres and a synergist as raw materials. According to the present invention, livestock and poultry manure, lees residue, furfural residue and other organic matters are used as the matrix, such that the complete nutrients are provided for crops; sodium selenite is used as the selenium source to provide selenium for crops, and polylactic acid/glycolic acid nanometer microspheres are addedto effectively and completely adsorb nutrients and selenium so as to achieve sustained release and avoid contamination of selenite to soil; by adding polyaspartic acid and rhamnolipid as the synergist, the efficient absorption of selenium by crops can be promoted; the added microbial agent can control the soil-borne fungi and bacterial diseases of various crops; and the product can effectively adjust the soil structure and improve the soil condition.

column12: Anti-influenza sustained-release pellet and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses an anti-influenza sustained-release pellet and a preparation method thereof. The pellet comprises a pellet core, an isolation layer coating and a controlled-release layer coating. The pellet core consists of anti-influenza spray-dried powder, polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer and an excipient; the isolation layer coating consists of Opadry; and the controlled-releaselayer coating consists of ethyl cellulose and controlled-release layer coating auxiliary materials. The controlled-release layer coating auxiliary materials consist of glycerol triacetate, tween-80, stearic acid, 5 parts of talcum powder and PVPK30. The anti-influenza spray-dried powder, the polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer, microcrystalline cellulose and starch are taken as raw materials,the pellet core is prepared by an extrusion and rounding method, and ethanol is taken as a wetting agent; the Opadry is taken as the isolation layer coating; and the ethyl cellulose are performed to and the controlled-release layer coating auxiliary materials are used as the controlled-release layer coating so as to obtain the pellet, and then drying and sieving are performed to obtain the targetanti-influenza sustained-release pellet. The method is simple and strong in operability, ingredients are safe, one-time clinical administration is adopted, and the pellet is suitable for the veterinary industry.

column12: Degradable (P3/4HB-PCL)-PU medical biliary stent material and preparation method thereof
column13: The present invention discloses a degradable (P3/4HB-PCL)-PU medical biliary stent material and a preparation method thereof. The degradable TAXOL-(P3/4HB-PCL)-PU nano-biliary stent is formed by a special soluble core-shaft-assisted coaxial electrospinning technology. The stent has biocompatibility, safety, drug controlled release and benign biliary stricture prevention effect.

column12: ABSORBABLE IMPLANTS FOR PLASTIC SURGERY
column13: Absorbable implants for breast surgery that conform to the breast parenchyma and surrounding chest wall have been developed. These implants support newly lifted breast parenchyma, and/or a breast implant. The implants have mechanical properties sufficient to support a reconstructed breast, and allow the in-growth of tissue into the implant as it degrades. The implants have a strength retention profile allowing the support of the breast to be transitioned from the implant to regenerated host tissue, without significant loss of support. Three-dimensional implants for use in minimally invasive mastopexy/breast reconstruction procedures are also described, that confer shape to a patient's breast. These implants are self-reinforced, can be temporarily deformed, implanted in a suitably dissected tissue plane, and resume their preformed three-dimensional shape. The implants are preferably made from poly-4-hydroxybutyrate (P4HB) and copolymers thereof. The implants have suture pullout strengths that can resist the mechanical loads exerted on the reconstructed breast.

column12: Preparation method of PLGA-PEG amphiphilic monodisperse nano drug carrier
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a PLGA-PEG amphiphilic monodisperse nano drug carrier. The method includes the steps of: dissolving a polylactic acid-glycolic acid and polyethylene glycol copolymer in an organic solvent to form an organic phase and dissolving an emulsifier in ultrapure water to form an aqueous phase; adding the organic phase into the aqueous phase to form a nanoscale emulsified solution with oil in water in ultrasound under magnetic stirring; stirring the above emulsifier at room temperature for 3-24 hours to remove the organic solvent and conducting refrigerated centrifugation and washing a precipitate to obtain a nanocarrier. Nanoparticles are regular in spherical shape with the particle size of 100-400 nm with uniform size, are suitable for encapsulatinga hydrophobic or fat-soluble drug, and have the advantages of biodegradability, improvement of drug bioavailability and drug release control.

column12: BIOERODIBLE DRUG DELIVERY DEVICES
column13: This invention relates to a bioerodible drug delivery device that can be implanted in a patient at or near an area in need of treatment. The bioerodible drug delivery device can be used to deliver a wide variety of different pharmaceutically active agents, and can do so at a controlled rate and over an extended period of time. The bioerodible drug delivery device includes a bioerodible polymeric outer housing with one or more delivery ports for delivering the pharmaceutically active agent(s) contained therein. The polymer used as the bioerodible polymeric outer housing is not substantially degraded during the dosing of the pharmaceutically active agent(s) in the bioerodible drug delivery device. The invention also provides methods of making the bioerodible drug delivery device and using it for the treatment of diseases and disorders.

column12: Biodegradable composite nano-material and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention provides a biodegradable composite nano-material. The biodegradable composite nano-material is prepared from 1 to 10 parts by weight of silicate modified polycaprolactone, 2 to 8 parts by weight of chitosan modified polylactic acid and 0.1 to 0.5 parts by weight of a nano-dispersant through melting and blending. The nano-dispersant comprises nanometer aluminum oxide, nanometer titanium oxide, nanometer zirconia and glass fibers. The invention also provides a preparation method of the biodegradable composite nano-material. A preparation method of the biodegradable composite nano-material comprises preparing a silicate-modified polycaprolactone and a chitosan-modified polylactic acid, preparing a nano-dispersing agent, and melting and blending the polycaprolactone, chitosan-modified polylactic acid and nano-dispersing agent to obtain the biodegradable composite nano-material. The preparation method is easy to operate. The biodegradable composite nano-material has stable properties, realizes controllable degradation and can be used as a good medical sustained-release material.

column13: The invention relates to a preparation method of a mizolastine sustained release preparation. The dosage of a capsule material is moderate, the drying temperature of the material is low, the obtained drug-loading preparation is uniform, the drug release is stable, and the mizolastine sustained release preparation has sustained release characteristics.

column12: Magneto-thermo dual-sensitive fluorescent glue beammicelle particle and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to a magneto-thermo dual-sensitive fluorescent glue beammicelle particle and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: synthesizing a thermosensitive P(NIPAM-co-DMAM)-b-PLA triblock copolymer by taking N-isopropylacrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide and polylactic acid as raw materials, then assembling a dextran-magnetic lamellar compound hydroxide-fluorouracil magnetic sustained and controlled release drug delivery system to a core of a thermosensitive glue beammicelle through a synchronous hydration and dialysis method so as to prepare a magneto-thermo dual-sensitive fluorescent glue beammicelle with magnetic response and temperature sensitivity, then grafting water-soluble near-infrared CdHgTe quantum dots (QD) on the surface of a magneto-thermo dual-sensitive thermosensitive glue beammicelle layer by using an electrostatic bonding technique, and finally preparing a DMF@TRM@QD fluorescent glue beammicelle particle with near-infraredfluorescence emission, magnetic targeting and thermosensitive controlled-release properties. The magneto-thermo dual-sensitive fluorescent glue beammicelle particle has appropriate low critical solution temperature (LCST ), is simple in process, low in cost, high in drug loading capacity, excellent in water solubility and high in sol stability, has a desirable thermosensitive property, magnetic targeting property and fluorescence tracing function, and has special application prospects in the fields of targetinged therapy and magneto-thermal therapy of tumors.

The preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving gliclazide into ethanol of 95 percent to obtain a solution A, and adding hydroxypropyl beta-cyclodextrin and mannitol into the solution A to obtain a solution B; dissolving polylactic acid and polyethylene glycol 200 into acetone to obtain a solution C, mixing the solution B and the solution C to obtain a solution D, transferring the solution D into a magnetic stirrer, continuously stirring the solution D for 12 hours, reducing the temperature of the solution D to 0 to 1 DEG C within in 2 hours, standing for 12 hours, and maintaining the temperature of the solution D to be 0 to 1 DEG C in the standing period; after standing for 12 hours, heating the solution D, increasing the temperature of the solution D to 15 to 18 DEG C, continuously stirring, controlling the temperature of the solution D to 15 to 18 DEG C during stirring, and preparing the gliclazide sustained release preparation by a low-temperature spray drying method after continuously stirring for 12 hours. The use amount of a capsule material is moderate, the drying temperature of materials is low, and the prepared medicine-loading preparation is uniform in size and stable in medicine release and has the sustained control characteristic.

column12: Preparation method of a propranolol sustained release preparation
column13: The invention provides a preparation method of a propranolol sustained release preparation. The preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving propranolol in 95% ethyl alcohol to obtaina solution A, adding adding hydroxypropyl beta-cyclodextrin and mannitol into the solution A to obtain a solution B; dissolving polylactic acid and polyethylene glycol 200 into acetone to obtain a solution C; mixing the solution B and the solution C to obtain a solution D, transferring the solution D into a magnetic stirrer, continuously stirring the solution D for 12 hours, reducing the temperature of the solution D to 0 DEG C to 1 DEG C within 2 hours, then standing for 12 hours, and maintaining the temperature of the solution D to 0 DEG C to 1 DEG C in the standing process; heating the solution D after standing for 12 hours, continuously stirring after the temperature of the solution D is raised to 15 DEG C to 18 DEG C, controlling the temperature of the solution D to 15 DEG C to 18 DEGC in the stirring process, and preparing the propranolol sustained release preparation through a low-temperature spray drying method after continuously stirring for 12 hours. The use level of a capsule material is moderate, the drying temperature of the material is low, the size of the prepared drug loading preparations is even, the drug is stably relased, and the drug has the characteristic of sustained release.

column12: BIOERODIBLE DRUG DELIVERY DEVICES
column13: This invention relates to a bioerodible drug delivery device that can be implanted in a patient at or near an area in need of treatment. The bioerodible drug delivery device can be used to deliver a wide variety of different pharmaceutically active agents, and can do so at a controlled rate and over an extended period of time. The bioerodible drug delivery device includes a bioerodible polymeric outer housing with one or more delivery ports for delivering the pharmaceutically active agent(s) contained therein. The polymer used as the bioerodible polymeric outer housing is not substantially degraded during the dosing of the pharmaceutically active agent(s) in the bioerodible drug delivery device. The invention also provides methods of making the bioerodible drug delivery device and using it for the treatment of diseases and disorders.

column12: Preparation method of biological material of macromolecule degradable drug carrier
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a biological material of a macromolecule degradable drug carrier. According to the process, the biological material of a macromolecule degradable drug carrier is prepared by performing the steps of ultrasonic oscillating and dispersing, sieving and sorting, vacuum heating and reaction, injection molding and die pressing, cooling and fixing, ultrasonic cleaning, positive and negative polyelectrolyte aqueous solution adsorption balancing, washing and airing, nitrogen-protected curing and the like on materials including ethylene glycol, polylactic acid, polypropylene ammonia, polyhydroxyvalerate, phosphatidylinositol, calcium chloride, sodium alginate, phosphatidylserine, glycine, dithiothreitol and the like. The prepared biological material ofa macromolecule degradable drug carrier has relatively high condition degradation performance, and is steady and non-toxic, and suitable for application to multiple materials related to drug carriers.

column12: Microsphere for double protection of antibody drug and intravitreal injection, and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention provides a microsphere for double protection of antibody drug and intravitreal injection, and a preparation method thereof. Particles of a monoclonal antibody drug are prepared by adopting a method of water phase-water phase emulsification, polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer and polyketal are utilized as carrier materials, and a sustained release microsphere that wraps and carries the particles of a dextran-monoclonal antibody drug is prepared by employing an emulsion solvent volatilization method of water phase-oil phase-solid phase. Denaturation and aggregation of antibodies are caused by an acidic microenvironment of polylactic acid-glycolic acid in an organic phase/aqueous phase interface and a degradation process, the drug loading capacity of the microsphere is increased and a burst release phenomenon during a releasing process of the microsphere is reduced, and double protection on the monoclonal antibody drug of the microsphere is achieved; the polyketal enables the drug loading capacity of the microsphere to be increased, enables the stimulation of an acidic degradation product of the polylactic acid and glycolic acid on eye environment to be reduce, andenables side effects such as endophthalmitis to be reduced; and the microsphere can release the monoclonal antibody for not less than 28 days in the in vitro environment and for not less than 2 monthsin the eye, and so, the frequency of administration can be reduced, pain of patients and economic burden are reduced, and the compliance of patients is improved.

column12: Polylactic acid microspheres, a preparation method thereof and applications of the microspheres in drug sustained release
column13: The invention discloses polylactic acid microspheres. A preparation method of the polylactic acid microspheres includes adding oil-soluble magnetic Fe3O4 nanoparticles into a chloroform solution of polylactic acid; then adding or not adding a drug; adding an aqueous solution of carboxyethyl chitosan; adding an emulsifier; performing ultrasonic dispersion; heating the mixture to 45-55 DEG C; addingan initiator to initiate polymerization; after the reaction is finished, performing vacuum distillation to remove chloroform; performing centrifugation to collect the microspheres; performing ultrasonic suspension and washing with distilled water; performing centrifugation; and collecting a product. column12: Pesticide sustained release microsphere and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention aims to disclose a pesticide sustained release microsphere and a preparation method thereof. The pesticide sustained release microsphere is composed of a core material and a wall material, wherein a mass ratio of the core material to the wall material is 1 to 1-6. The pesticide sustained release microsphere is characterized in that the wall material is prepared from polylactic acid (PLA) and poly(butylene succinate) (PBS) in a mass ratio of 1 to 1-9; the core material is prepared from two pesticide active compounds. By the use of the characteristic of high curing rate in an emulsification process, the PLA is mixed with the PBS to prepare the wall material to increase the settling rate in an emulsifying shear process, so that the encapsulation efficiency of a drug is effectively improved; furthermore, after the PLA and the PBS are mixed, the number of holes in the surface of the microsphere can be effectively decreased, and the drug release time is prolonged. The pesticidesustained release microsphere disclosed by the invention is uniform in particle size and regular in shape; the encapsulation efficiency of the pesticide active compounds is over 70 percent, and the drug release time lasts for 25 days or longer; furthermore, after the drug is completely released, the wall material can be biologically degraded without causing pollution.

column12: Preparation method of sandwich-type composite film stent
column13: The invention provides a preparation method of a sandwich-type composite film stent. A polylactic acid/bioactive glass/chitosan sandwich-type composite film carrier loaded with bioactive factors is created. The preparation method includes 1), preparing a polylactic acid film, mesoporous bioactive glass loaded with the bioactive factors and a chitosan film loaded with seed cells as an outer sealinglayer, a sandwich layer and an inner controlled release and stem cell stent layer respectively; 2), coating the polylactic acid film with the sandwich layer of the bioactive glass loaded with the bioactive factors, and loading the bioactive glass layer with the chitosan film loaded with the seed cells to create the sandwich-type composite film carrier. The preparation method has the advantages that the problem of incapability of repairing and treating single nerve tracts impaired (but not died yet) in the prior art can be solved; the problems that oriented release of drugs cannot be realizedand high concentration of impaired local factors cannot be guaranteed by existing drug delivery systems are also solved.

column12: Methods and compositions particularly for treatment of attention deficit disorder
column13: There is described, inter alia, a coated bead comprising: (a) a granule; (b) a first layer coated over the granule, the first layer comprising a first amount of an active pharmaceutical ingredient comprising a central nervous system stimulant; and (c) a second layer coated over the first layer, the second layer being present in an amount sufficient to substantially delay release of the active pharmaceutical ingredient in the first layer until after the coated bead reaches a distal intestine portion of a subject to whom the coated bead is administered; and (d) the third layer coated over the second layer, the third layer comprising a second amount of the active pharmaceutical ingredient, the third layer being configured to permit substantially immediate release of the active pharmaceutical ingredient comprised therein. Embodiments related to a solid oral pharmaceutical composition are also described.

column12: Drug-loading sustained-release support composite body for treating infectious bone defect
column13: The invention relates to a drug-loading sustained-release support composite body for treating infectious bone defect. The drug-loading sustained-release support composite body is prepared by the stepthat vancomycin is encapsulated by polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer to prepare sustained release microspheres and loaded to a beta-tricalcium phosphate support. The vancomycin, with broad-spectrum antibacterial capacity, is encapsulated by the polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer to prepare into sustained microspheres, and loaded to the beta-tricalcium phosphate support to prepare a novel drug-loading sustained-release anti-infection bone substitute material which can slowly release the vancomycin at a part of the infectious bone defect. When being applied to treating the infectiousbone defect, the material can release the encapsulated vancomycin in an all-dimensional mode for a long time in a partial three-dimensional space of the infectious bone defect after being embedded; thus, the purpose of controlling infection within the focus of infection is achieved; meanwhile, the effects of filling bone defect, promoting bone formation and quickening bone reconstruction are achieved.

column12: Digestive tract patency capsule
column13: Disclosed is a digestive tract patency capsule, comprising an outer membrane (2) and a supporting material (1) which is soluble in digestive juices. The cavity of the capsule body of the outer membrane (2) is provided with an indicator (5) which can be absorbed by the body and enables the discharged urine to change color. The supporting material (1) is provided in the cavity of the capsule body of the outer membrane (2) to support the outer membrane (2) in a capsule form. The digestive tract patency capsule can safely and effectively check the feasibility of performing a capsule endoscopic examination on a user. The digestive tract patency capsule can predict the feasibility of a capsule endoscopic examination and is taken before performing a capsule endoscopic examination on a patient, thus safely, simply and effectively providing a good basis for the determination of whether a capsule endoscopic examination should be performed for a clinician.

column13: The present invention relates to gene transfer composition using a tri-block polymer electrolyte being polyethyleneimine-polylactic-acid-polyethylene-glycol. column12: SINGLE-LAYER ORAL DOSE OF NEURO-ATTENUATING KETAMINE
column13: The present invention is directed to oral neuro-attenuating ketamine (NAKET) tablet formulations, and methods of administration, which ensure the steady release of a therapeutically effective concentration of ketamine from an oral tablet without neurologically toxic spikes in ketamine concentration. In particular, the present invention provides single layer oral tablet formulation of NAKET. In a specific embodiment, the NAKET tablet formulation, and methods of administration provide steady administration of NAKET to a subject for 24 hours or greater, for example, up to 36 hours, after a single administration event.

column12: Artificial bone material and preparation method of artificial bone
column13: The invention discloses an artificial bone material and a preparation method of the artificial bone. The preparation method comprises the following steps: adding 1-2 parts of growth hormone release peptide and 4-6 parts of a sustained release preparation into 80-100 parts of hydrogen peroxide with a mass fraction concentration of 5%, so as to obtain a mixture A; mixing 100-120 parts of a polylactic acid-hydroxyacetic acid copolymer, 20-30 parts of shell powder and 4-8 parts of scale powder, adding 200-220 parts of deionized water into the mixture, so as to obtain a mixture B; mixing the mixture A with the mixture B, and stirring by virtue of a high-speed stirrer at 50-60 DEG C until the mixture A and the mixture B are uniformly stirred into paste, so as to obtain a mixture C; and slowly extruding the mixture C into a mold, putting the mold into a subzero temperature environment, and standing until the artificial bone in the mold is formed, so as to obtain an artificial bone primary component. The artificial bone material has the advantages of good consistency, relatively high porosity and specific surface area and convenience in cell adhesion; and the artificial bone is internallyloaded with growth factors beneficial to seed cells, and the growth factors can be slowly released, so that the growth of the cells is promoted.

column12: Pesticide controlled-release carrier as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a pesticide controlled-release carrier as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The pesticide controlled-release carrier comprises a porous structural medium and a surface layer plugging material; the porous structural medium for adsorbing a crude drug of a pesticide is plugged by using the surface layer plugging material; the porous structural medium comprises polylactic acid or aluminum oxide; and raw materials for preparing the surface layer plugging material include hydrocarbonate, a molecular sieve, guar gum, cellulose ether and gelatin. The structure of the pesticide controlled-release carrier is improved, so that the pesticide controlled-release effect is improved; in addition, no novel pollution sources are introduced; and the invention discloses the preparation and use methods of the pesticide controlled-release carrier.

The first and second polymeric components may be the same polymer.

column12: Propiconazole. flusilazole-polylactic acid sustained release microsphere and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a propiconazole. flusilazole-polylactic acid microsphere and a preparation method thereof. The method uses propiconazole. flusilazole as a core material and polylactic acid asa wall material to prepare the propiconazole. flusilazole-polylactic acid microsphere through a solvent evaporation method. Through a single factor test-orthogonal test combined method, the influencecaused by emulsification time, an emulsifier concentration, a stirring speed, a volume ratio of oil to water phase, a concentration of polylactic acid and a mass ratio of the core to wall material onthe preparation process of polylactic acid microspheres is investigated. The result shows that different microsphere preparation factors produce difference to the encapsulation efficiency, drug load and particle size of the propiconazole. flusilazole-polylactic acid microsphere. Through optimizing the preparation processes, the best conditions in microsphere preparation such as a core-wall material mass ratio of 1: 3, a polylactic acid concentration of 180 mg/ml, an emulsifier concentration of 1.5%, an oil-water volume ratio of 1: 25 and a high emulsifying dispersion speed of 4000 rpm/min areselected.

column12: Targeting atherosclerotic focus cell membrane bionic drug-delivery system preparation method and product and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to a targeting atherosclerotic focus cell membrane bionic drug-delivery system preparation method and a product and an application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: extracting a macrophage membrane, repeatedly extruding the macrophage membrane to prepare macrophage membrane vesicle, then mixing the material with polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer nanoparticles, and repeatedly extruding a filter membrane to prepare a spherical drug-delivery system. The system has an obvious core/shell structure, an average particle size is 167+/-6.12 nm, and alpha4beta1 integrin is kept on the surface; a VCAM-1 acceptor can be effectively identified, and the system can present good in-vitro and vivo targeting, and is expected to be used for treating atherosclerosis and related diseases.

column12: Preparation method of magnetic nanometer drug-loading sustained-release microspheres encapsulating 5-fluorouracil
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of magnetic nanometer drug-loading sustained-release microspheres encapsulating 5-fluorouracil. The specific steps comprises: 1) adding the mixture of magnetic nanoparticles ferroferric oxide and 5-fluorouracil into an alkaline solution, carrying out ultrasound and stirring, and carrying out freeze drying to obtain black freeze drying powder; 2) dissolving chitosan in an organic solvent containing polylactic acid to obtain an organic mixed solution; 3) adding the black freeze drying powder to the organic mixed solution, and carrying out ultrasound and stirring to obtain a first mixed emulsion; 4) adding the first mixed emulsion to a deionized water solution containing methyl cellulose to obtain a second mixed emulsion; and 5) stirring the secondmixed emulsion, centrifuging, and washing to obtain the target product. According to the present invention, the defect of the short sustained release time of the 5-fluorouracil preparation is overcome by using the high magnetic adsorption performance and the chemical bond effect of the magnetic nanoparticles ferroferric oxide on the 5-fluorouracil, and the obtained product can effectively treat large-area bone defect diseases caused by bone tumors.

column12: INTRACAMERAL DRUG DELIVERY DEPOTS
column13: Methods of treating an eye for an ocular condition such as placing a composite depot comprising a xerogel with embedded degradable particles into an anterior chamber of an eye to deliver a therapeutic agent. The xerogel is a hydrogel after exposure to intraocular fluid and is degradable. The degradable particles comprise the therapeutic agent and hydrolytically degrade in the anterior chamber to provide a controlled release of the therapeutic agent into the eye. Materials and processes for making depots are provided as well as alternative methods of their use.

column12: Health fiber preparation process
column13: Ginseng stems and leaves are used to prepare a fiber product, production cost is reduced, and the fiber product still has a certain degree of drug effect. A polylactic acid solution is used as the main body of a spinning solution, and polylactic acid fiber is used as the main part of the health fiber, ground ginseng leaf and ginseng stem components are mixed in the polylactic acid fiber, and porous graphene particles are also added to the fiber. The porous graphene particles have strong adsorptivity and can absorb the active components in the ginseng stems and leaves, so that a sustained release effect can be achieved. The polylactic acid fiber itself is degradable and can be naturally degraded after being discarded without polluting the environment.

column12: Sepia latimanus ripening method and special reagent
column13: The invention discloses a sepia latimanus ripening method and a special reagent. The ripening method comprises the steps of conducting live body soaking and anesthesia on sepia latimanus; using a sterile scalpel to cut the orbital sinus under eyes of sepias, implanting reagent special for ripening into the orbital sinus and coating wounds with external application consolidant to heal the wounds. The reagent special for ripening is a slow-release embedding medium and is prepared from, by weight, 0.06-0.08 parts of serotonin, 0.01-0.012 part of human chorionic gonadotropin, 0.13-0.15 part of leuteinizing hormone releasing hormone analogue, 0.004-0.006 part of hypophysis cerebri organ extract, 0.011-0.013 part of arachidonic acid and 1-2 parts of polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer. The sepia latimanus ripening method has the advantages that the ripening method can quickly ripen, is safe, harmless and easy to operate and no longer relies on natural reproduction and oviposition of sepia latimanus; the reagent special for ripening has high stability and slow release or controlled release properties.

column12: Single-layer oral dose of neuro-attenuating ketamine
column13: The present invention is directed to oral neuro-attenuating ketamine (NAKET) tablet formulations, and methods of administration, which ensure the steady release of a therapeutically effective concentration of ketamine from an oral tablet without neurologically toxic spikes in ketamine concentration. In particular, the present invention provides single layer oral tablet formulation of NAKET. In a specific embodiment, the NAKET tablet formulation, and methods of administration provide steady administration of NAKET to a subject for 24 hours or greater, for example, up to 36 hours, after a single administration event.

column13: Provided are drug delivery compositions and devices useful for the treatment and/or prevention of cancer and metastatic tumors. column12: POROUS POLYMER MATERIAL, PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR, AND BIOMATERIAL USING SAME
column13: The present invention relates to: a porous polymer material having a porous structure over the entire polymer and having a dense porous structure in which pores are connected to each other therein. The porous polymer material is harmless to the human body as it does not use toxic organic solvents. In addition, a porous polymer material can be prepared without using any additives for forming pores and the particle size can be easily controlled, and thus a polymer material suitable for various uses can be prepared. Furthermore, the extended release of a loaded bioactive material is possible only by the dense porous structure of a polymer itself without using an additive and a surface modification method in the porous polymer material of the present invention. Therefore, the porous polymer material can be applied to a biodegradable material in various bio-fields requiring the extended release of a bioactive material.

column12: Bactericidal sustained-release microsphere and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention provides a bactericidal sustained-release microsphere and a preparation method thereof. According to the method, a systemic triazole compound bactericide, i.e., difenoconazole-flusilazole technical, is used as a core material, and a degradable polymer material, i.e., polylactic acid, is used as a wall material; and a solvent evaporation process is employed for preparation of the bactericidal sustained-release microsphere. The preparation method of the invention solves the problems of easy drifting, easy degradation, low utilization rate and the like of traditional pesticides; andpolylactic acid is used as a wrapping material and has the characteristics of safety, low toxicity, easy degradation, environmental safety and the like compared with traditional chemical synthetic materials such as polyurea, urea formaldehyde resin, polyurethane and polyamide. Through compounding of pesticides and preparation of the sustained-release microsphere, a prevention and treatment spectrum is broadened; pesticide efficacy is improved; environmental pollution is reduced; prevention and treatment cost is lowered; and the requirements of pollution-free agricultural production are met.

column12: Morphine controlled release system
column13: A oral pharmaceutical composition for controlled release of an opioid from a pharmaceutical composition is described that comprises (i) an erodible matrix composition comprising a mixture of (a) a polymer or a mixture of polymers (b) an opioid, and optionally, (c) one or more pharmaceutically acceptable excipients; and (ii) a single, substantially insoluble in and impermeable coating having two openings exposing at least one surface of the matrix, and comprising one or more polymers. The composition exhibits controlled release of the opioid by erosion of the matrix and exhibits a zero order release profile wherein about 75% w/w of the opioid is released from the composition within 4-10 hours when tested in a dissolution test as described herein.

column12: Hydrogel encapsulated cells and anti-inflammatory drugs
column13: A composition containing biocompatible hydrogel encapsulating mammalian cells and anti-inflammatory drugs is disclosed. The encapsulated cells have reduced fibrotic overgrowth after implantation in a subject. The compositions contain a biocompatible hydrogel having encapsulated therein mammalian cells and anti-inflammatory drugs or polymeric particles loaded with anti-inflammatory drugs. The anti-inflammatory drugs are released from the composition after transplantation in an amount effective to inhibit fibrosis of the composition for at least ten days. Methods for identifying and selecting suitable anti-inflammatory drug-loaded particles to prevent fibrosis of encapsulated cells are also described. Methods of treating a disease in a subject are also disclosed that involve administering a therapeutically effective amount of the disclosed encapsulated cells to the subject.

column12: Preparation method for amphiphilic macromolecule reversed-phase microemulsion based on oil phase

The invention has the advantages that after introduction of cyclodextrin into the oil-phase-based amphiphilic macromolecule reversed-phase microemulsion, the maximum BSA encapsulation rate of the reversed-phase microemulsion can be increased from 60% to 72%; the preparation method is simple in process, easily practicable, and low incost; and the prepared microemulsion can be widely applied to controlled release, emulsification and separation of drugs in a plurality of fields like materials science, biology and medicine.

column12: Doxorubicin precursor compound having photo-responding degradation, and preparation and application of same
column13: The invention relates to a doxorubicin precursor compound which can be released under photo-response, and a preparation method and an application of same. The doxorubicin precursor compound is represented as the formula (I) and has following advantages: the compound contains a photo-sensitive group, which is connected to a strong-hydrophobic group; and then with an amphiphilic polymer, polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer (PLGA), which has excellent biocompatibility, as a supporter, a hydrophobic photo-responding doxorubicin prodrug molecule (DOC) is embedded in a hydrophobic core of a nano-micelle, which is formed by the PLGA; under light irradiation, the hydrophobic prodrug molecule is degraded into hydrophilic doxorubicin, which is easy to escape from the nano-supporter PLGA, thus achieving the effects of the doxorubicin. The method achieves photo-controlled release of the medicine, and solves the problems of intensive toxic and side effects since the medicine cannot be released at certain time and certain points due to incomplete release and sudden release of a doxorubicin preparation in the prior art.

column12: Gamma-polyglutamic acid/polylactic acid biocompatible nanofiber membrane and preparing method
column13: The invention relates to a gamma-polyglutamic acid/polylactic acid biocompatible nanofiber membrane and a preparing method. The preparing method includes the steps that gamma-polyglutamic acid and polylactic acid are dissolved according to the certain proportion (1:10 to 3:10) into a compounded solvent of trifluoroacetic acid and trichloromethane, wherein the volume ratio of the trifluoroacetic acid to the trichloromethane is 1:1, and an even solution with the certain concentration (15% to 18%, wt) is prepared; the nanofiber membrane is prepared with the electrospinning technology. The gamma-polyglutamic acid has the good water-retaining property and biocompatibility, and is nontoxic, harmless and edible; the polylactic acid is renewable, degradable and good in biocompatibility, and is an environment-friendly high polymer material. The composite nanofiber membrane prepared with the method has the advantages that the composite nanofiber membrane has the good biocompatibility, and is nontoxic and degradable, harmful substances are not generated, the good mechanical property is achieved, the hydrophobic property of the polylactic acid is improved, and products can be widely applied to the field of biological tissue culturing, medical ingredients, drug carriers and the like.

column12: Composite pharmaceutical ingredient loaded nanoparticle
column13: The invention provides a composite pharmaceutical ingredient loaded nanoparticle. The nanoparticle is modified by a cationic surfactant; the nanoparticle is loaded with a composite medicine of heparin, taxol and fluvastatin; and the cationic surfactant is dilauryl dimethyl ammonium bromide. The invention also provides a preparation method and an application of the composite pharmaceutical ingredient loaded nanoparticle. According to the nanoparticle provided by the invention, a polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer nano-microsphere which is loaded with the heparin, the taxol and the fluvastatin is adopted, and the nano-microsphere is subjected to surface modification by virtue of the cationic surfactant, namely dilauryl dimethyl bromide, through a physical adsorption method, so that a novel intravascular drug delivery system is formed. The adsorption force of the drug delivery system is enhanced, and the residence time of the system in vascular endothelium is prolonged.
