column12: Nano-drug carrier material and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention provides a nano-drug carrier material and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) mixing carboxymethyl chitosan, cottonseed oil, polyoxyethylene sorbitan monostearate and de-ionized water; stirring and reacting for 1h to 1.5h; (2) adding hyaluronic acid, fibroin protein, soybean isolate protein, polylactic acid, syzygium buxifolium leaf alcohol and polyethylene glycol; carrying out ultrasonic shearing; (3) adding cationic starch, hydroxypropyl methylcellulose and glutaraldehyde, and heating and stirring; (4) standing and separating to obtain a water phase; regulating the pH (Potential of Hydrogen) value to be 8 and carrying out low-speed centrifuging to remove relatively large grains; (5) regulating the pH value of a suspension solution to be neutral and centrifuging for 3min to 5min at a rotary speed of 2500r/min to 3000r/min; removing a solvent and drying to obtain the nano-drug carrier material. The nano-drug carrier material provided by the invention has relatively high water absorption, excellent hydrophilic performance and relatively rapid degradation speed; meanwhile, the nano-drug carrier material has a very good drug slow release effect.

column12: Pharmaceutical dosage form
column13: A pH responsive and mucoadhesive pharmaceutical dosage form for the release of a pharmaceutically active agent is described. The dosage form includes a mucoadhesive layer for site-specific mucoadhesion, a water-insoluble outer layer, and an intermediate layer including one or more pharmaceutically active agents for site-specific delivery. The different membranous layers perform different functions in order to create a drug delivery system which is able to deliver a drug to a specific site, for a particular period of time and with a specific drug release pattern. The dosage form can have two or more intermediate layers, each layer comprising an active agent. The mucoadhesive layer can also include an active agents. The dosage form is preferably an oral or buccal delivery form for release of the active agent into the gastro intestinal tract. The intermediate layer can be an electrospun fibrous membrane layer containing the active agent.

column12: Double-layer membrane for spinal cord treatment
column13: The invention provides a double-layer membrane for spinal cord treatment. The double-layer membrane comprises a dense outer layer and an inner layer from top to bottom, wherein the dense outer layer is a polylactic acid membrane; the inner layer is a chitosan membrane supported with seed cells and mesoporous bioactive glass spheres; and bioactive factors are supported in the mesoporous bioactive glass spheres. The double-layer membrane is square or circular. The bioactive factors refer to nerve growth stimulating factors. The double-layer membrane aims to solve the problems in the prior art that a single damaged (but not dead) nerve tract cannot be repaired and treated; the problem that targeted release of the medicine cannot be realized by the conventional drug delivery system, and high concentrations of damaged local factors cannot be guaranteed, the problems that most of drug delivery systems are easy to degrade and low in drug-loading rate and drug release cannot always penetrate through the spinal cord injury repair process, and the problems that the drug delivery system is extremely large in volume, possibly compresses the spinal cord and is unfavorable for suture of duramater spinalis so as to cause leakage of a cerebrospinal fluid.

column12: Method for preparing copolymer micelle of polyacrylic acid-poly trimethylene carbonate-polylactic acid-polypropylene glycol

column12: Preparation Method of Drug-Containing Sustained Release Microparticles
column13: The present invention relates to a preparation method of drug-containing sustained release microparticles, the preparation method comprising the steps of: (a) dissolving a biodegradable polymer and a drug in a halogenated alkane solvent to form a drug-containing biodegradable polymer solution; (b) homogeneously mixing the drug-containing biodegradable polymer solution in a continuous phase containing a surfactant to form a dispersed phase; (c) maintaining an emulsion comprising the continuous phase and the dispersed phase at a temperature lower than the boiling point of the halogenated alkane solvent to form microparticles in the continuous phase; (d) primarily drying the microparticles; (e) mixing the primarily dried microparticles with an aqueous alcohol solution, and then maintaining the aqueous alcohol solution at a temperature no less than the boiling point of the halogenated alkane solvent to extract and evaporate the remaining halogenated alkane solvent from the microparticles; and (f) secondarily drying the obtained microparticles to produce drug-containing microparticles. The drug-containing sustained release microparticles prepared in accordance with the preparation method of the present invention minimize the hydrolysis of the biodegradable polymer in the microparticles, while easily removing the halogenated alkane solvent in the microparticles, and are thus capable of exhibiting excellent sustained drug release.

column12: Preparation method of polyacrylic acid-poly(p-dioxanone)-poly (trimethylene carbonate)-polylactic acid copolymer micelle
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of polyacrylic acid-poly(p-dioxanone)-poly (trimethylene carbonate)-polylactic acid copolymer micelle. The preparation method comprises following steps: 1, polyacrylic acid, poly(p-dioxanone), a solvent, and a condensing agent are delivered into a dried reactor, and a polyacrylic acid poly(p-dioxanone) copolymer is obtained via reaction; 2, the polyacrylic acid poly(p-dioxanone) copolymer, poly (trimethylene carbonate), polylactic acid, the solvent, and the condensing agent are delivered into a dried reactor, reaction is carried out so as to obtain a polyacrylic acid-poly(p-dioxanone)-poly (trimethylene carbonate)-polylactic acid copolymer; 3, the polyacrylic acid-poly(p-dioxanone-poly (trimethylene carbonate)-polylactic acid copolymer and the solvent are delivered into a dried reactor for dissolving so as to obtain a polyacrylic acid-poly(p-dioxanone)-poly (trimethylene carbonate)-polylactic acid copolymer stock solution; and 4, the polyacrylic acid-poly(p-dioxanone)-poly (trimethylene carbonate)-polylactic acid copolymer stock solution is delivered into a dialysis bag, the dialysis bag is delivered into a beaker containing a selective solvent, the selective solvent is replaced for 3 to 4 times, the solution in the dialysis bag is delivered into a volumetric flask with scales, and is diluted with the selective solvent to a certain volume so as to obtain a target product. The preparation method is simple; operation is convenient; and the obtained target product is a novel drug carrier.

column12: Method for preparing polyacrylic acid-poly(p-dioxanone)-polylactic copolymer micelle
column13: The invention discloses a method for preparing a polyacrylic acid-poly(p-dioxanone)-polylactic copolymer micelle. The method comprises the following steps: 1) adding polyacrylic acid, hydroxyl-terminated poly(p-dioxanone) monododecyl ether, a solvent and a condensing agent into a reactor, and reacting to obtain a polyacrylic acid-poly(p-dioxanone) grafted copolymer; 2) adding the grafted copolymer, hydroxyl-terminated polylactic acid monotridecyl ether, a solvent and a condensing agent into the reactor, and reacting to obtain a polyacrylic acid-poly(p-dioxanone)-polylactic double-grafted copolymer; 3) adding the double-grafted copolymer and a solvent into the reactor, and dissolving to obtain a double-grafted copolymer stock solution; 4) adding the stock solution into a dialysis bag, putting the dialysis bag into a beaker filled with a selective solvent, performing replacement for 3-4 times, pouring into a volumetric flask with scales, and adjusting the scales, thereby obtaining the target in the invention. The method disclosed by the invention is simple in preparation process and easy to master, and the obtained target is a novel drug carrier.

column12: Ibuprofen mesoporous material and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of production research of drug loading materials, and in particular, relates to an ibuprofen mesoporous material and a preparation method thereof; the ibuprofen mesoporous material is prepared from the following raw materials of chitosan, polylactic acid, ibuprofen, and ionic liquid. column13: The invention discloses a paclitaxel-polylactic acid-paclitaxel structure copolymer and a preparation method thereof. column12: Chitosan-polylactic acid sustained-release microcapsule coating matrine and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a chitosan-polylactic acid sustained-release microcapsule coating matrine. The preparation method of the microcapsule is characterized by comprising the following steps: at first, using a combined technology of ultrasonic extraction and microwave extraction and trichloromethane extraction to extract and separate matrine; then carrying out crosslinking and grafting between chitosan and lactic acid to obtain chitosan grafted polylactic acid; and finally preparing the sustained-release microcapsule by taking the chitosan grafted polylactic acid as the coating carrier. The provided chitosan-polylactic acid sustained-release microcapsule coating matrine has the advantages that the technology is simple, the coating rate is high; the raw materials are all derived from plants, the microcapsule is safe and environment-friendly therefore; and the effect on killing mosquitoes and insects is good.

column12: SUBLIMABLE SUSTAINED RELEASE DELIVERY SYSTEM AND METHOD OF MAKING SAME
CORE-SHELL-TYPE PARTICLE AND METHOD FOR PRODUCING SAME
column13: Provided are core-shell particles which are kept stable in a solvent such as water for a long period. Each core-shell particle includes a core which contains a hydrophobic polymer having an anionic group and a shell which contains calcium phosphate. At least one of calcium atoms contained in calcium phosphate is chemically bonded to a functional group derived from the anionic group. In a method of manufacturing core-shell particles each core-shell particle includes a core which contains a hydrophobic polymer and a shell which contains calcium phosphate, the method includes the steps of: mixing a water-soluble organic solution which contains a hydrophobic polymer having an anionic group with a solution which contains calcium ion so as to obtain a first mixed solution; mixing the first mixed solution with a solution which contains phosphate ions so as to obtain a second mixed solution; and stirring the second mixed solution.

column12: Combined tumor targeted treatment system based on photodynamic therapy and chemotherapy
column13: The invention belongs to the field of medicinal preparations, and relates to a targeted nanometer delivery release system aiming at a multidrug resistant tumor and a preparation method of the targeted nanometer delivery release system. According to the system and the preparation method, the photosensitizer, namely, pyrophaeophorbide-a (PPA) is bonded to two ends of the copolymer, namely, hydroxylated-polylactic acid-polyglycolic acid (HO-PLA-PEG-PLA-OH) through a chemical bonding method, thus the product, namely, the photosensitizer-embedded polylactic acid-polyglycolic acid polymer (PPA-PLA-PEG-PLA-PPA) is obtained, then the chemotherapy medicine, namely, paclitaxel is encapsulated physically by adopting an emulsified solvent evaporation method, thus the binary-drug-loading nanometer delivery release system (PPA NP-PTX) is prepared, then F3 peptide with the specific targeting function and the cell penetrating function is modified on the surface of the system, and thus the photodynamic therapy and chemotherapy combined drug delivery nanometer delivery release system with the binary targeting property is prepared. The experiment proves that the delivery system has the strong lethal effect for drug resistant tumor cells, has the obvious in-vivo tumor targeting effect, and has the obvious treatment effect for the mice bearing the multidrug resistant tumor, and thus the combined drug delivery nanometer system has the clinical application prospect.

column13: The invention discloses a drug sustained release bracket which is formed by a naked bracket and a coating coated to the bracket. column12: Preparation method of bone synthesis promoting drug carrying nano particle liposome-polymer
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of bone synthesis promoting drug carrying nano particle liposome-polymer. The bone matrix mineralization difference between a bone resorption area, where bone-resorbing cells aggregate, and a bone formation area, where bone forming cells aggregate, in BMU is utilized to design a nano targeting drug delivering system with specific selectivity. Liposome, which is connected to an aspartic acid and serine repetitive sequence DSS6, polylactic acid-hydroxyacetic acid copolymer, and lecithin are taken as the raw materials, and a bone synthesis promoting drug is added to synthesize the bone synthesis promoting drug carrying nano particle liposome-polymer. The nano particles containing the bone synthesis promoting drug has specific affinity on hydroxyapatite with a low mineralization degree, so nano particles are specifically distributed in the bone formation area, where bone forming cells aggregate after entering the bone tissues, and the side effect of the bone synthesis promoting drug is largely reduced. The nano drug carrying system has the advantages of self long circulation, targeting property, and sustained releasing function and can overcome the shortages of conventional bone synthesis promoting drugs such as low bioavailability, bad stability, short pharmacologic action time, and the like.

column12: Method for preparing antitumor pH-sensitive and non-pH-sensitive dextran-polylactic acid-polyethylene glycol nanoparticle drug delivery system
column13: The invention relates to a method for preparing antitumor pH-sensitive and non-pH-sensitive dextran-polylactic acid-polyethylene glycol drug nanoparticles. The method comprises the following steps: taking cheap and readily available polyethylene glycol as an initial raw material, and performing ring opening polymerization with lactic acid (D, L-lactide) so as to obtain a polylactic acid-polyethylene glycol polymer (mPEG-PLA); reacting with butanedioic anhydride, and producing a polylactic acid-polyethylene glycol polymer (mPEG-PLA-COOH)with carboxyl; carrying out an esterification reaction with dextran so as to obtain a carrier of dextran-polylactic acid-polyethylene glycol (Dextran-PEG-PLA); and enabling the polymer to react with methoxypropene and propionic anhydride on the basis of the carrier, thereby obtaining the pH-sensitive (Acetalated-Dextran-PEG-PLA (ADP) and non-pH-sensitive dextran-polylactic acid-polyethylene glycol nano carrier (Propionic-Dextran-PEG-PLA (PDP). The nano-carrier preparation method is simple, the raw materials are cheap and readily available, the preparation process is simple in operation, and the nano-carrier is applicable to serving as a carrier of clinical drugs.

column12: Star-shaped polylactic acid and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to star-shaped polylactic acid and a preparation method thereof. A molecular structure of star-shaped polylactic acid high molecules is composed of porphyrin core at center and four polylactic acid branched chains. According to the invention, lactide, a catalyst and an initiator are placed in a polymerization apparatus, vacuum and inert gas are used for displacing a polymerization apparatus for 3 times, under the temperature of 120-150 DEG C, a polymerization is carried out for a certain time, so that a star-shaped polylactic acid high-molecular material is obtained. The initiator is polyfunctional porphyrin and is metal cooperation object, the catalyst is selected from stannous octoate, dibutyl tin diacetate, or dibutyltin dilaurate or a mixing catalyst of the above materials. the star-shaped polylactic acid has the advantages of compact structure and high chain segment density, compared with a linear polymer having same molecular amount, the solution viscosity is less, and the prepared star-shaped polylactic acid has important application prospect on the fields of a drug carrier, a postoperative anti-adhesion film, light chemotherapy and pH response.

column12: PREPARATION METHOD OF DRUG-CONTAINING SUSTAINED RELEASE MICROPARTICLES
column13: The present invention relates to a preparation method of drug-containing sustained release microparticles, the preparation method comprising the steps of: (a) dissolving a biodegradable polymer and a drug in a halogenated alkane solvent to form a drug-containing biodegradable polymer solution; (b) homogeneously mixing the drug-containing biodegradable polymer solution in a continuous phase containing a surfactant to form a dispersed phase; (c) maintaining an emulsion comprising the continuous phase and the dispersed phase at a temperature lower than the boiling point of the halogenated alkane solvent to form microparticles in the continuous phase; (d) primarily drying the microparticles; (e) mixing the primarily dried microparticles with an aqueous alcohol solution, and then maintaining the aqueous alcohol solution at a temperature no less than the boiling point of the halogenated alkane solvent to extract and evaporate the remaining halogenated alkane solvent from the microparticles; and (f) secondarily drying the obtained microparticles to produce drug-containing microparticles. The drug-containing sustained release microparticles prepared in accordance with the preparation method of the present invention minimize the hydrolysis of the biodegradable polymer in the microparticles, while easily removing the halogenated alkane solvent in the microparticles, and are thus capable of exhibiting excellent sustained drug release.

column12: System and method for multiphasic release of growth factors
column13: A system for multiphasic delivery of at least one growth factor at a treatment site comprises a delivery vehicle for releasing at least one growth factor in an initial release profile and a carrier for releasing at least one growth factor in a sustained release profile. The initial release profile releases at least one growth factor over a period of hours to days, wherein the growth factor is released in a large amount initially, with the remainder being released in progressively lower amounts. The sustained release profile releases at least one growth factor over a period of days to weeks, wherein the growth factor is released at a generally constant amount over such period. The system of the invention is particularly suited for applications on bioimplants. The invention also comprises methods and kits for multiphasic delivery of at least one growth factor.

column12: Drug delivery system for targeting co-delivery of photosensitizer and chemotherapeutic drug
column13: The invention belongs to the field of pharmaceutical preparations and relates to a drug delivery system for targeting co-delivery of a photosensitizer and a chemotherapeutic drug. According to the drug delivery system, a nanometer preparation is prepared from vitamin E polyethylene glycol succinate-L-polylactic acid as a raw material, a chemotherapeutic drug adriamycin is wrapped in a hydrophobic inner core of the nanometer preparation, simultaneously, a photosensitizer chlorin e6 is connected to vitamin E polyethylene glycol succinate (TPGS) through a covalent bond, then the compound is inserted into a shell structure of the nanometer preparation so that efficient and stable coating of the chemotherapeutic drug and the photosensitizer is realized, and a polypeptide tLyp-1 having a targeting function modifies the surface of the nanometer preparation through a covalent bond so that nanometer preparation vascular permeability and tumor penetrability are promoted. Results of in-vitro and in-vivo experiments show that the drug delivery system is used for treatment on tumors resisting multiple drugs, has the characteristics of good targeting ability, high efficiency and low toxicity, and has a clinical application prospect.

column12: Nanolipogel vehicles for controlled delivery of different pharmaceutical agents
column13: A “nanolipogel” is a delivery vehicle including one or more lipid layer surrounding a hydrogel core, which may include an absorbent such as a cyclodextrin or ion-exchange resin. Nanolipogels can be constructed so as to incorporate a variety of different chemical entities that can subsequently be released in a controlled fashion. These different incorporated chemical entities can differ dramatically with respect to size and composition. Nanolipogels have been constructed to contain co-encapsulated proteins as well as small hydrophobic drugs within the interior of the lipid bilayer. Agents incorporated within nanolipogels can be released into the milieu in a controlled fashion, for example, nanolipogels provide a means of achieving simultaneous sustained release of agents that differ widely in chemical composition and molecular weight. Additionally, nanolipogels can favorably modulate biodistribution.

column12: Methods of treating inflammatory and autoimmune diseases and disorders using nanolipogels
column13: Compositions and methods for treating or ameliorating the symptoms of inflammatory or autoimmune disease or disorder are described herein. The compositions contain a nanolipogel for sustained delivery of an effective amount of one or more active agents of choice, preferably a drug for treating or ameliorating the symptoms of inflammatory or autoimmune disease or disorder. The nanolipogel includes a lipid bilayer surrounding a hydrogel core, which may optionally include a host molecule, for example, an absorbent such as a cyclodextrin or ion-exchange resin. In preferred embodiments at least one of active agents is an immunosuppressant.

column12: Efficient controlled release fertilizer favorably improving taste and freshness of ivy mosses and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses an efficient controlled release fertilizer favorably improving taste and freshness of ivy mosses. The fertilizer comprises the following components in parts by weight: oyster shells, polylactic acid, expanded graphite, thermally activated nano chernozem, pinecones, pomegranate barks, mosses, sugarcane ash, a soil beneficial microbial inoculant, bacitracin zinc, phytase, amino acid, ground calcium ammonium sulfate, boric acid, sodium selenite, chelated iron, potassium fulvate, lysine, a proper amount of hydrogen peroxide, a proper amount of ammonia water, a proper amount of water and the like. The coated controlled release fertilizer is prepared by using the pinecones, the pomegranate barks, the mosses and the sugarcane ash which are matched with nutritional substances through fermentation. The fertilizer is rich in nutrient elements such as fermented small molecular organic matters, calcium, iron, selenium and zinc, is abundant in nutrient and convenient for plants to absorb and utilize, so that the taste and freshness of the ivy mosses can be enhanced; by adopting the coating layer which can supply oxygen and dynamically adjust the porosity, the fertilizer efficiency time is long, organic matter nutrients can be released for a long time, efficient cultivation of the ivy mosses can be realized, and the fertilizer can be widely applied and popularized.

column12: Efficient controlled-release fertilizer capable of improving quality of virus-free potatoes and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses an efficient controlled-release fertilizer capable of improving the quality of virus-free potatoes. The efficient controlled-released fertilizer is prepared from the following components in parts by weight: oyster shell, polylactic acid, nano-viscous kaolin, sepiolite fabric, zanthoxylum oil dregs, aschersonia powder, bacteriophage powder, selenium-enriched yeast, white rot fungi, potassium sulphate, manganese sulfate, ferrous sulfate, ammonium sulfate, sodium borate, diammonium phosphate, fulvic acid, metalloprotease, ammonium tetrachlorocuprate, fish protein, indoleacetic acid, pepper leaf extract, herba portulacae extract, a proper amount of hydrogen peroxide, a proper amount of ammonium hydroxide and a proper amount of water. The sepiolite fabric, the zanthoxylum oil dregs, the aschersonia powder and the bacteriophage powder are matched with nutrients, and are fermented to prepare a film-coated controlled-release fertilizer; the fertilizer is rich in fermentation small molecular organic matters and natural sterilizing substances, is rich in nutrients, can be easily absorbed and utilized by potatoes, facilitates the synthesis, metabolism and growth of in-vivo protease, ensures safe culture of the virus-free potatoes, and can be widely applied and popularized.

column12: Efficient cultivation fertilizer for lobular crowndaisy chrysanthemum and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses an efficient cultivation fertilizer for lobular crowndaisy chrysanthemum. The fertilizer comprises the following components in parts by weight: oyster shells, polylactic acid, common-rush-based porous biomass carbon, nano viscous loess, sisal hemp residues, distillers' grains, seaweed shells, leftovers of edible mushrooms, microbial zymophyte, melatonin, saponin, naphthylacetic acid, epsilon-polylysine, a proper amount of hydrogen peroxide, a proper amount of ammonia water, a proper amount of water and the like. The coated controlled release fertilizer is prepared by using the sisal hemp residues, the distillers' grains, the seaweed shells and the leftovers of the edible mushrooms which are matched with nutritional substances through fermentation. The fertilizer is rich in organic matters and abundant in nutrient; by adopting the coating layer which can supply oxygen and dynamically adjust the porosity, the fertilizer efficiency time is long, organic matter nutrients can be released for a long time, the photosynthesis and metabolism of the lobular crowndaisy chrysanthemum can be promoted, the quality of the lobular crowndaisy chrysanthemum can be improved, and efficient cultivation of the lobular crowndaisy chrysanthemum is realized. The materials of the coated fertilizer are wide in source, the price cost is low, the preparation process is simple to operate, the function is remarkable, and the fertilizer can be widely applied and popularized.

column12: Florfenicol gel implant for veterinary use and preparation method of florfenicol gel implant
column13: The invention relates to a florfenicol gel implant for veterinary use. The florfenicol gel implant is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 2-5 parts of florfenicol, 4-10 parts of doxycycline hydrochloride, 8-12 parts of polylactic acid, 8-12 parts of PLGA, 70-90 parts of nitrogen-methyl pyrrolidone, 0.01-5 parts of poloxamer 188, 0.01-2 parts of monoethanolamine and 5-20 parts of benzyl alcohol. According to the florfenicol gel implant for veterinary use provided by the invention, through the combined application of the florfenicol and the doxycycline hydrochloride, a synergistic effect is achieved among the medicines, and the gel implant is prepared into the form of a sustained-release injection, so that an antibacterial effect is enhanced and a curative effect is improved; the appearance of drug-resistance bacteria is delayed or relieved; an antibacterial scope is widened for mixed infections; the doses of some medicines can be reduced, so that toxic and side reactions are relieved; and in addition, the cost of the florfenicol, which is used in a single mode, can be reduced.

column12: Efficient green Chinese onion planting fertilizer rich in microelements and preparing method of efficient green Chinese onion planting fertilizer
column13: The invention discloses efficient green Chinese onion planting fertilizer rich in microelements. The efficient green Chinese onion planting fertilizer comprises, by weight, oyster shells, polylactic acid, sodium bentonite, potassium mineral powder, manioc waste, furfural residues, oil residues, saccharomycetes, phosphobacteria, potassium bacteria, cytokinin, a proper amount of hydrogen peroxide, a proper amount of ammonium hydroxide and the like. The potassium mineral powder, the manioc waste, the furfural residues and the oil residues are adopted to be matched with nutrient substances, enveloping controlled release fertilizer is prepared after fermentation, the fertilizer is rich in organic matter, mineral elements and microelements, and nutrients are abundant. An enveloping layer capable of supplying oxygen and dynamically adjusting holes is adopted, the fertilizer effect time is long, organic matter nutrients can be released for a long time, metabolism of green Chinese onions can be promoted, the nitrogen and phosphorus utilization rate of the green Chinese onions is increased, the growth and photosynthesis of the green Chinese onions are promoted, and the utilization efficiency of the green Chinese onions for the fertilizer is improved, green Chinese onion plants are stout and strong in meat quality, the content of proteins, cellulose, mineral elements and microelements is increased, the quality of the green Chinese onions is improved, efficient cultivation of the green Chinese onions is improved, and the green Chinese onions can be widely popularized and applied.

column12: Efficient sustained-release fertilizer capable of increasing content of soluble saccharides in carambola fruits and preparation method for efficient sustained-release fertilizer
column13: The invention discloses an efficient sustained-release fertilizer capable of increasing the content of soluble saccharides in carambola fruits. The efficient sustained-release fertilizer is prepared from the following ingredients in parts by weight: oyster shells, polylactic acid, white carbon black, activated white clay, plant oil residues, dry cattle manure, humus, deodorizing bacteria, saccharomycetes, ammonium phosphate, potassium sulfate, zinc sulfate, citric acid, borax, eucalyptol, potassium fulvate, compound amino acid initial powder, catechin, viscous starch paste, sodium lauryl sulfate, a proper volume of hydrogen peroxide, a proper volume of ammonia water and a proper volume of water. According to the efficient sustained-release fertilizer, the coated sustained-release fertilizer is prepared through enabling the activated white clay, the plant oil residues, the dry cattle manure and the humus to be matched with the eucalyptol, the catechin and the like and carrying out fermentation; and the fertilizer is rich in organic matters, a coating layer which can be used for supplying oxygen and dynamically adjusting pores is adopted, the nutrition is rich, and the fertilizer effect duration is long, so that nutrients can be released in long time, the growth and development of carambola fruits can be promoted, the increase of the content of the soluble saccharides in the carambola fruits is promoted, the efficient cultivation of the carambola fruits is promoted, and thus, the efficient sustained-release fertilizer can be extensively used and popularized.

column12: Degradable polymer core-shell microsphere loaded with protein drugs
column13: The invention provides a degradable polymer core-shell microsphere loaded with protein drugs. The core structure of the microsphere is a chemical crosslinked gel core formed by mixing and electronic injection of a hyaluronic acid derivate and a hydroxyethyl chitosan solution, and a shell is made from lactic acid-glycollic acid copolymer, or polycaprolactone or polylactic acid and used for embedding protein and polypeptide drugs, and includes bovine serum albumin, or interferon or cytochrome C. The microsphere of a dual-layer structure has the degradable polymer shell, combines the comprehensive advantages of gel pack drug microspheres and degradable polymer microspheres, and is a gel microsphere preparation which is high in drug loading amount and encapsulation efficiency and good in drug release performance. The obtained core-shell microsphere serves as a interferon long-acting controlled release preparation, has the outstanding advantages of being formed through one step, low in cost and good in drug embedding comprehensive effect, and is large in application potential.

column13: The invention discloses a high efficient sustained release fertilizer capable of improving the stress resistance and output of paddy rice. The fertilizer comprises oyster shell, polylactic acid, edible fungus residues, waste tea tree residues, fulvic acid, bamboo charcoal fiber, biomass carbon powder, bacillus subtilis inoculant, saccharomyces cerevisiae inoculant, ammonium dihydrogen phosphate, hydrogenated castor oil, sodium hydrogen sulfate powder, trace elements, compound sodium nitrophenolate, chitosan lactate, hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose, a proper amount of hydrogen peroxide, a proper amount of ammonia water, and a proper amount of water. column13: The invention discloses an efficient controlled release fertilizer helping to improve awnless brome quality and product. column12: Advanced heart failure treatment material as myocardial/cardiovascular regeneration device
column13: Provided is an advanced heart failure treatment material, as a myocardial/cardiovascular regeneration device, that self-assembles, which can improve the universality and be used in an emergency by commercialization with no need of cell-culturing (cell-free) by controlling stem cells, and has a high therapeutic effect on the fundamental treatment of intractable cardiovascular diseases, in particular, advanced heart failure, in which not only the saving of lives but also improving the patient's quality of life (QOL) are urgent issues. column12: Preparation process for sustained-release chlorine dioxide antibacterial film
column13: The invention discloses a preparation process for a sustained-release chlorine dioxide antibacterial film. The preparation process prepares a reaction type chlorine dioxide antibacterial film by using polyvinyl alcohol and polylactic acid as main base materials and compounding a film A and a film B through a wet process, wherein the film A is prepared through the following steps: selecting polyvinyl alcohol as a film-forming base material, preparing a polyvinyl alcohol gel aqueous solution by using a stable chlorine dioxide aqueous solution, then carrying out drying through a casting process so as to form a film, and with glycerol as a plasticizer, adding carboxymethyl cellulose so as to increase hygroscopicity of the film and promote the release of chlorine dioxide; and the film B is prepared through the following steps: selecting the polylactic acid as a film-forming base material, dissolving the polylactic acid with dichloromethane, adding one selected from the group consisting of an activator citric acid or tartaric acid into the obtained solution, adding a plasticizer and an antioxidant, and carrying out casting so as to form a film. The chlorine dioxide antibacterial film prepared by using the preparation process provided by the invention needs water to activate, thereby being able to be used as a packaging material of fruits and vegetables with high water content, wherein the water released by the respiratory action of the fruits and the vegetables activates a chlorine dioxide antibacterial agent, so the water in the package is reduced; meanwhile, the growth of microorganisms is inhibited; and the shelf life of the fruits and the vegetables is prolonged.

column12: Apremilast sustained-release implant and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention provides an Apremilast sustained-release implant, which includes 30wt%-40wt% of Apremilast, 0-20wt% of polylactic acid, 30wt%-60wt% of polylactic acid-polyglycolic acid copolymer and 0-10wt% of polyethylene glycol 60000, wherein the total content of the above components is 100%. The method uses polylactic acid and polylactic acid-polyglycolic acid copolymer as auxiliary materials to prepare Apremilast into the sustained-release implant; by local injection of the implant, diffusion and degradation of biological materials, the drug is released; and the drug release speed can be adjusted and controlled according to the amount and ratio of drug excipients. The implant maintains the effective blood concentration of a target site, reduces toxic and side effects produced by systemic medication, significantly reduces the number of medication and drug dose, improves medication safety, and broadens the application scope of such drugs.

column12: DIGESTIVE TRACT PATENCY CAPSULE
column13: Disclosed is a digestive tract patency capsule, comprising an outer membrane (2) and a supporting material (1) which is soluble in digestive juices. The outer membrane (2) is a sealed soft capsule body made from a sustained-release enteric material, and the dissolution time of the outer membrane (2) is greater than the normal emptying time of the human digestive tract. The cavity of the capsule body of the outer membrane (2) is provided with an indicator (5) which can be absorbed by the body and enables the discharged urine to change color. The supporting material (1) is provided in the cavity of the capsule body of the outer membrane (2) to support the outer membrane (2) in a capsule form. The digestive tract patency capsule can safely and effectively check the feasibility of performing a capsule endoscopic examination on a user. The digestive tract patency capsule can predict the feasibility of a capsule endoscopic examination and is taken before performing a capsule endoscopic examination on a patient, thus safely, simply and effectively providing a good basis for the determination of whether a capsule endoscopic examination should be performed for a clinician.

column12: PROCESS FOR PREPARING A BIO-RESORBABLE POLYESTER IN THE FORM OF A POWDER
column13: The invention refers to a Process for preparing a bio-resorbable polyester the form of a powder with a bulk density of 0.3 g/ml or more, a tapped density of 0.4 g/ml or more and a specific surface area of 2.0 m2/g or less comprising the steps a. dissolving a bio-resorbable polyester in a first solvent to form a polymer solution, b. contacting the polymer solution with a second solvent which is a non-solvent for the bioresorbable polyester and which is mainly water to result the precipitation of the bio-resorbable polyester in the form of a wet polymer mass, c. pre-drying the wet polymer mass at a temperature below the TgO of the bio-resorbable polyester, d. comminuting the pre-dried polymer mass to polymer particles with a size below 10 mm, e. drying the comminuted polymer particles below the TgO of the bio-resorbable polyester to a residual water content of 1% or less by weight/weight, f. post-treatment of the polymer particles from step e at a temperature in the range from the TgO to the TgE of the bio-resorbable polyester, g. comminuting the polymer particles from step f to a powder with a particle size of d50 of 1-300 μm and d90 of more than 30 and up to 3000 μm.

column12: Vaginal matrices: nanofibers for contraception and prevention of HIV infection
column13: Described are drug delivery systems incorporating electrospun fibers that comprise and deliver physicochemically diverse drug compounds. Such fibers provide significant advantages in drug agent release, such as adaptability for solid dosage delivery to mucosal tissues. This is in addition to allowing for controlled drug release. Systems and methods for large-scale electrospinning productivity are described, including novel microarchitectures allowing for variable pharmacokinetics in drug release.

column12: SINGLE-LAYER ORAL DOSE OF NEURO-ATTENUATING KETAMINE
column13: The present invention is directed to oral neuro-attenuating ketamine (NAKET) tablet formulations, and methods of administration, which ensure the steady release of a therapeutically effective concentration of ketamine from an oral tablet without neurologically toxic spikes in ketamine concentration. In particular, the present invention provides single layer oral tablet formulation of NAKET. In a specific embodiment, the NAKET tablet formulation, and methods of administration provide steady administration of NAKET to a subject for 24 hours or greater, for example, up to 36 hours, after a single administration event.

column12: METHODS FOR REDUCING OR PREVENTING TRANSPLANT REJECTION IN THE EYE AND INTRAOCULAR IMPLANTS FOR USE THEREFOR
column13: Methods for reducing or preventing transplant rejection in the eye of an individual are described, comprising: a) performing an ocular transplant procedure; and b) implanting in the eye a bioerodible drug delivery system comprising an immunosuppressive agent and a bioerodible polymer.

column12: Apparatus, system, and method for forming nanofibers and nanofiber webs
column13: A nozzle, die, apparatus, system and method for forming a fiber population having a median diameter less than one micrometer, and nonwoven fibrous webs including a population of such sub-micrometer fibers. The nozzle includes a first conduit having a first terminal end, a second conduit positioned coaxially around the first conduit and having a second terminal end proximate the first terminal end, wherein the first and second conduit form an annular channel between the first and second conduit, and additionally wherein the first terminal end extends axially outwardly beyond the second terminal end. The die includes at least one such nozzle, and the apparatus and system include at least one such die. Methods of making nonwoven fibrous webs including a population of sub-micrometer fibers, and articles including such nonwoven fibrous webs, are also disclosed.

column12: Core-shell sustained release nanosphere and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a core-shell sustained release nanosphere, which consists of a hydrophobic drug carrier, a hydrophobic core constituted by hydrophobic drugs adsorbed on the hydrophobic drug carrier and lecithin covering the hydrophobic core, wherein the hydrophobic drug carrier is star cholic acid functional polylactic acid; and the mass ratio of the lecithin to the star cholic acid functional polylactic acid to the hydrophobic drugs is (30-80) to (10-20) to 1. The core-shell sustained release nanosphere disclosed by the invention, by taking the star cholic acid functional polylactic acid as the hydrophobic drug carrier and covering the core with the lipidosome (the lecithin), has the advantages of being excellent in sustained release effect, biodegradable, good in biocompatibility, narrow in particle size distribution, stable in property, applicable to injection to parenteral drug delivery and the like.

column12: Morphine controlled release system
column13: Described are controlled release oral pharmaceutical composition comprising an erodible matrix composition comprising a polyethylene oxide, a therapeutically effective amount of an opioid or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt, complex, solvate or anhydrate thereof, or a mixture thereof and, optionally, one or more pharmaceutically acceptable excipients, and a coating on the matrix composition, wherein the coating has at least one opening exposing a surface of an end portion of the matrix composition, thereby allowing controlled release of the opioid by erosion of the matrix surface, wherein the composition exhibits zero order release of at least 80% of the opioid contained in the composition. column12: SUNITINIB FORMULATIONS AND METHODS FOR USE THEREOF IN TREATMENT OF OCULAR DISORDERS
column13: Methods for increasing the encapsulation or incorporation of Sunitinib into polymeric matrices have been developed. The resulting formulations provide for more sustained controlled release of sunitinib or its analog or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof. Increased loading is achieved using an alkaline solvent system. The pharmaceutical compositions can be administered to treat or prevent a disease or disorder in or on the eye of a patient associated with vascularization, such as corneal neovascularization and acute macular degeneration. Upon administration, the sunitinib or its analog or salt is released over an extended period of time at concentrations which are high enough to produce therapeutic benefit, but low enough to avoid unacceptable levels of cytotoxicity.

column12: Preparation method of protein and polypeptide sustained release microspheres of biologically active glass composite polylactic acid
column13: The invention discloses preparation of protein and polypeptide sustained release microspheres of biologically active glass composite polylactic acid and belongs to the field of medicine.Each sustained release microsphere is mainly composed of a polylactic acid type biodegradable material (PLGA (polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer) or PLA (polylactic acid)), bioglass and a main drug.The preparation method has the advantages that in the process when an emulsified solvent volatilizing method is adopted for preparing protide and polypeptide drug sustained release microspheres, an inorganic biomedical material, namely biologically active glass, is composited, by adjusting the proportion of composition of the biologically active glass, the degradation rate which is almost synchronous with a polylactic acid biodegradable material is achieved, low pH generated in the polylactic acid biodegradable material degradation process is neutralized through slow formation of carbonated hydroxyapatite, and thereby stability of the protein and polypeptide drugs in the microsphere preservation and releasing processes is improved synchronously.

column12: Preparation method of bionic nanofiber scaffold with electrical stimulation effects
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a composite bionic nanofiber scaffold with electrical stimulation effects. Beta-tricalcium phosphate is polarized for 0.5-3 hours in air with the effects of a 2-8KV/cm-1 direct-current electric field at 200-600 DEG C, and polarized beta-TCP is obtained; polylactic acid is dissolved in an organic solvent, the polarized beta-TCP powder is added, and PLA/beta-TCP pre-electrospinning liquid 1 is prepared; a medicament with biological activity is added in an aqueous solution of chitosan-acetic acid with uniformly stirring for dispersion, and CS/medicament with biological activity pre-electrospinning liquid 2 is prepared; PLA/CS/beta-TCP is prepared by coaxial electrospinning. The nanofiber scaffold with electrical stimulation effects has a double layer internal structure and a large surface area, in order to realize timely and proper controlled release of neurotrophic factors and various medicaments; the nanofiber scaffold has the advantages of good biological compatibility, stable performance, preservation convenience, and good application prospects in peripheral nerve repair and other biomedical fields.

column12: PEG-PLGA sustained release microsphere with encapsulated buprenorphine and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a PEG-PLGA sustained release microsphere with encapsulated buprenorphine and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method is as below: conducting debydrochlorination on buprenorphine to prepare alkali, and conducting a single emulsion method to obtain the PEG-PLGA sustained release microsphere with encapsulated buprenorphine. The weight ratio of buprenorphine (calculated by buprenorphine hydrochloride) to polyethylene glycol-polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer is 2-6:10, and the buprenorphine sustained release microsphere has particle size of 10-50 micron. The invention employs for the first time the hydrochloric acid-single emulsion method to prepare the buprenorphine sustained release microspheres with high drug loading, obvious sustained-release effect and good biocompatibility, and can develop a variety of administration approaches, such as intravenous injection, and subcutaneous and intramuscular non-intravenous administration approaches. The invention has good application prospect, and can improve patient compliance.

column12: Drug delivery system for glioma cell and dependent vessel
column13: The invention belongs to the field of medicinal preparation and relates to a targeted drug delivery system for brain glioma in situ and a preparation method thereof. A drug delivery system capable of brain glioma targeted drug delivery is established in the invention. According to the drug delivery system, biodegradable polylactic acid with good in vivo compatibility is used as a raw material to prepare a nano-preparation (NP); the NP is surface-modified with polyethylene glycol to prolong in vivo circulation time; and simultaneously, by a covalent linkage mode, the material is surface-modified with targeting functional molecules to achieve the purpose of targeted drug delivery. It shows through in vivo and in vitro experiments that the drug delivery system can specifically gather at tumor sites. Efficacy results show that the system has a remarkable antitumor effect and has a wide prospect in clinic application.

column12: Charge reversal Pulullan derivative and synthesis method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to a charge reversal Pulullan derivative and a synthesis method and application thereof. column12: Preparation method of hollow polylactic acid microcapsules consisting of poly(L-lactic acid) and poly(D-lactic acid)
column13: The invention relates to a preparation method of hollow polylactic acid microcapsules consisting of poly(L-lactic acid) and poly(D-lactic acid). The method comprises steps as follows: adding a poly(L-lactic acid) solution or a poly(D-lactic acid) solution to calcium carbonate particles, and performing oscillation and centrifugal washing to obtain single-layer polylactic acid microspheres; adding the poly(D-lactic acid) solution or the poly(L-lactic acid) solution to the single-layer polylactic acid microspheres, and performing oscillation and centrifugal washing to obtain double-layer polylactic acid microspheres; repeating the steps to obtain multi-layer polylactic acid microspheres; adding an acid solution to the multi-layer polylactic acid microspheres, removing calcium carbonate, and performing centrifugal washing to obtain the hollow polylactic acid microcapsules. The assembly process is simple, the condition is mild, and no special equipment is required; the particle size distribution of the prepared polylactic acid microcapsules is uniform, the particle size and the capsule wall thickness can be controlled accurately, so that controlled release of substances carried in the microcapsules is realized, and the preparation method can be widely applied to fields of drug sustained release, cosmetics and the like.

column12: Morphine controlled release system
Preparation method of polylactic acid based medicine-carrying controlled release material
column13: The invention provides a preparation method of a polylactic acid based medicine-carrying controlled release material. The method comprises the following steps: dissolving levorotatory polylactic acid into a benign solvent of the levorotatory polylactic acid to obtain a skin-layer spinning raw solution; dissolving a target drug and racemic polylactic acid into a benign solvent of the racemic polylactic acid to obtain a core-layer spinning raw solution; obtaining double-component skin-core type medicine-carrying long fibers by using a double-component spinning method; then removing the solvent and dividing the long fibers into short fibers, namely the polylactic acid based medicine-carrying controlled release material. With the adoption of the method, by utilizing the difference of degrading performances of the polylactic acid with different configurations, the controlled release carrier material which meets different medicine controlled release time and is matched with a plurality of types of drugs is prepared through selecting polylactic acid skin-core layer raw materials with different molecular weights and configurations to control the length of the fibers; the preparation process is simple and is convenient for industrialized production.

column13: The invention provides an SAK-HV oral controlled-release microsphere. A preparation method for the SAK-HV oral controlled-release microsphere comprises the following steps: dispersing a solution containing SAK-HV in a dispersion phase--an organic solvent containing a high-molecular material; then dispersing emulsified fine emulsion in another liquid immiscible with the fine emulsion to form a stable W/O/W emulsion; and removing a volatile solvent in the dispersion phase and allowing a skeletal material to form the microsphere through curing. Results of pharmacodynamic experiments with aopE-/-mouse show that the SAK-HV oral controlled-release microsphere has better lipid-lowering effect than the lipid-lowering effect of atorvastatin; and compared with atorvastatin, the SAK-HV oral controlled-release microsphere has smaller side effect on the liver and earlier action time.

column12: Preparation method of paliperidone sustained release microsphere injection
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a paliperidone sustained release microsphere injection. The preparation technology comprises the following steps: (1) paliperidone and an acid anhydrides reagent are respectively dissolved in a solvent to be subjected to esterification reaction under the effect of an alkaline catalyst; (2) the esterification product obtained in the step (1) is dissolved in anhydrous dichloromethane to be subjected to acylation reaction with the added acylation reagent with DMF (N, N- dimethylformamide) being the catalyst; (3) the acylated paliperidone is subjected to esterification reaction with polylactic acid (PLA) through chemical bond bonding; (4) paliperidone sustained release microspheres are prepared by adopting solvent evaporation method, and the paliperidone sustained release microspheres are prepared into the microsphere injection after being cooled and dried. The preparation method is safe to operate, mild in reaction condition and simple and clear in steps; the total yield reaches 50% or above; the particle sizes of the obtained paliperidone microspheres are 30-50 micron; the paliperidone sustained release microsphere injection provided by the invention is high in drug loading capacity, stable in drug release, long in drug release time and good in sustained release effect.

column12: Exenatide sustained release microsphere and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to an exenatide sustained release microsphere and a preparation method thereof. The exenatide sustained release microsphere preparation consists of exenatide, a heat sensitive protective agent and a polylactic acid and polyglycolic acid copolymer. The preparation is prepared by adopting a W1/O/W2 emulsifying method through the following steps: 1) dissolving exenatide and the heat sensitive protective agent into water to be used as internal phases W1, dissolving PLGA into an organic phase O, dissolving a surface active agent into water to be used as an external phase W2, adding the internal phases W1 into the organic phase O, and forming uniform colostrums W1/O under the action of high-speed homogeneity or vortexes; 2) then injecting colostrums W1/O into the external phase W2, and quickly stirring to form compound emulsion W1/O/W2; 3) stirring the compound emulsion W1/O/W2 and volatilizing to remove an organic solvent; or pouring compound emulsion W1/O/W2 into water containing sodium chloride, rising the temperature to be 35-40 DEG C, and removing all organic solvent so as to form the exenatide sustained release microsphere. According to the exenatide sustained release microsphere and the preparation method thereof, the drug release is slow, the dosing time is reduced, and the adaptability of patients is improved.

column12: Preparation method of health-care fiber containing nanometer selenium
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a health-care fiber containing nanometer selenium. The preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) adding a fiber forming polymer, namely polylactic acid, polyvinyl alcohol or polyacrylonitrile into a solvent, stirring the fiber forming polymer and the solvent until the fiber forming polymer is uniformly dissolved, after deaeration, adding nanometer selenium granules to the solution after deaeration, uniformly stirring the solution and the nanometer selenium granules, performing ultransonic deaeration through an ultrasonic processing device, and leaving the solution subjected to the ultransonic deaeration to stand so as to obtain a spinning stock solution; 2) pouring the spinning stock solution into a solution storing device, using a flush syringe needle as a capillary of a jet trickle, enabling the syringe needle and a high-voltage power supply to be connected to be used as an anode, wherein the flowing speed is 5*(10<-4>-10<-3>) mm/s, collecting fibers onto an earthing aluminum foil placed in front of the syringe needle, performing high-pressure electrostatic spinning, and performing vacuum drying at the normal atmospheric temperature so as to obtain the health-care fiber containing the nanometer selenium. The preparation method is simple and feasible, obtained products have a trace element, namely the selenium, required for a human body, and the health-care fiber can be processed into health-care textiles or a transdermal drug delivery system to be used for the human body.
